a: Kechatuch dame.
Keman? kerabbi meir, ditnan: kol yedot hakkelim shehen arukkot veatid lekotztzan – matbil ad makom midda, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: ad sheyyatbil et kullo.
Afillu tema rabbanan, chibbure ochalin keman demipparti dame, unegii bahadade.
Bishlama leulla, hayeynu dekatane "chatachah", ella leravina, may "chatachah"? ayyeyde ditna resha "chatachah", tena name sefa "chatachah".
Vachachamim omrim: magga terefa shechuta. terefa shechuta mi metammeya? in, kedaavu dishmuel, deamar avu dishmuel: terefa sheshshechatah metammea bemukedashin.
Ma matzinu bitrefa sheshshechitatah metahartah, af shechitat behema tetaher et haubbar.
Tanya, amar lahen rabbi meir: vechi mi tiharo leever ze mide nevela? shechitat immo! im ken, tattirennu baachila!
Amru lo: harebe matztzelet al sheeno gufah yoter miggufah, shehare shaninu: chotech min haubbar shebbemeeha – muttar baachila, min hattechol umin hakkelayot – asur baachila.

May kaamar? amar rava, veamri la kedi: chassore mechassera vehachi katane, amar lahen rabbi meir: vechi mi tiharo leever ze midde nevela? shechitat immo, im ken tattirennu baachila! amru lo: terefa tochiach, sheshshechitatah metahartah mide nevela veenah mattiratah baachila.

Amar lahen: lo, im tihara shechitat terefa otah, davar shehi gufah, tetaher et haever davar sheeno gufah? amru lo: harebe matztzelet al sheeno gufah yoter miggufah, shehare shaninu: chotech min haubbar shebbemeeha – muttar baachila, min hattechol umin hakkelayot – asur baachila.

Tanya name hachi: amar lahen rabbi meir: vechi mi tiharo leever ze midde nevela? amru lo: shechitat immo. im ken, tattirennu baachila! amru lo: terefa tochiach, sheshshechitatah metahartah mide nevela veenah mattiratah baachila.
Amar lahen: im tihara shechitat terefa otah veet haever hameduledal bah, davar sheggufah, tetaher et haubbar sheeno gufah?
Amru lo: harebe matztzelet al sheeno gufah yoter miggufah, shehare shaninu: chotech min haubbar shebbemeeha – muttar baachila, min hattechol umin hakkelayot – asur baachila.
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kemachloket beubbarin, kach machloket beevarin.
Verabbi yochanan amar: machloket beever deubbar, aval beever divhema – divre hakkol shechita osa nippul.
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may tama derabbi yochanan allibba derabbanan? hay it leh takkanta bachazara, veha let leh takkanta bachazara.
Metivi: amar lahem rabbi meir: lo, im tihara shechitat terefa otah veet haever hameduledal bah – davar sheggufah, tetaher et haubbar – davar sheeno gufah?
b: Bishlama lerabbi shimon ben lakish, ledivrehem kaamar lehu: ledidi la shena ever deubbar vela shena ever divhema, ki hadade ninhu.
Ella lerabbi yochanan, kashya.

Ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar: amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kemachloket beubbarim, kach machaloket beevarin, verabbi yochanan amar: machloket beever deubbar, aval beever divhema – divre hakkol en shechita osa nippul.
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may tama derabbi yochanan allibba derabbi meir? hay gufah, vehay lav gufah.
Amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim shemmita osa nippul, veen shechita osa nippul.
Bemay askinan? ilema beever deubbar – miflag peligi! ella beever divhema – mita tenena, shechita tenena.
Mita tenena: meta habbehema – habbasar tzarich hechsher, vehaever metamme mishshum ever min hachay, veeno metamme mishshum ever min hannevela; divre rabbi meir.
Shechita name tenena: nishchata behema – hucheshru bedameha, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon omer: lo hucheshru.
I mehahi, hava amena: may "hucheshru" – abbasar.
Veha "hucheshru" katane, mahu detema: chad levasar happoresh min habbehema, vechad levasar happoresh min haever.
Umay ulemeh dehay mehay? salka datach amena, hoil umetamme tumea chamura aggav aviv, ema la live hechsher, kamashma lan.

Amar rav yosef: nekot derav yitzchak bar yosef bidach, derabba bar bar chana kae kevavteh. detanya: "uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu" – lehavi haever vehabbasar hameduledalin bivhema uvechayya uveof, ushechatan, shehen asurin. veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan:

a: En bahen ella mitzvat perosh bilvad.

Yatev rav yosef kammeh derav huna, veyatev vekaamar: amar rav yehuda amar rav: achalo laze – loke. amar leh hahu merabbanan: la tetzitu leh, hachi amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta mishshemeh derav: achalo laze – eno loke.
Amar leh rav huna: anan amman nismoch? ahderinhu rav yosef leappeh, amar leh: may kusheya? ki amari ana – bemita, deosa nippul; ki amar ihu – bishchita, deenah osa nippul.

Amar rava: mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan: mita osa nippul, shechita enah osa nippul, dichtiv: "vechol asher yippol alav mehem bemotam yitma", lemaote may? illema lemaote bechayyehem – minnivlatam" nafka, ella shema minna: mita osa nippul, veen shechita osa nippul.
Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava: veha kera bishratzim ketiv! amar leh: im eno inyan lishratzim, delav bene shechita ninhu – tenehu inyan livhema.
Veakkatti mibbee leh, keen mita: lachin – metammeim, yeveshim – en metammeim! tere "bemotam" ketivi.
Amar rav chisda: machloket beever deubbar chay, aval beever deubbar met – divre hakkol shechita osa nippul. verabba amar: kemachloket baze kach machloket baze.
Ben shemone chay. vehatanya: ben shemone chay yochiach, sheaf al pi sheyyesh bemino shechita – en shechitato metaharto.
Amar rav kahana: yesh bemino shechita aggav immo, vetanna didan mina deimmeh la parech.

Ulehay tanna defarech, terefa dishchitatah metahartah mena leh? nafka leh midderav yehuda amar rav, deamar rav yehuda amar rav, veamri la bematnita tana: amar kera "vechi yamut min habbehema", miktzat behema metammea umiktzat behema enah metammea, veezo zo? zo terefa sheshshechatah.
Bae rav hoshaya: hoshit et yado lime behema, veshachat ben tisha chay, mahu? tibbee lerabbi meir, vetibbee lerabbanan.
Tibbee lerabbi meir: ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir ben pekua taun shechita – hane mille hecha deyatza laavir haolam, aval bime immo – la sharya leh shechita.
O dilma, afillu lerabbanan, arbaa simanin achshar beh rachamana.
Amar rav chananya, ta shema: hare shennolda terefa min habbeten, vei ita, mashkachat la dehayta lah sheat hakkosher, dei bae ayyel yedeh veshachata!
Amar leh rava: tane shennotzra terefa min habbeten, umashkachat la bevaalat chamesh raglayim.
Mishna hashshochet et habbehema, umatza bah ben shemone chay o met, o ben tisha met – koro umotzi et damo.
Matza ben tisha chay – taun shechita, vechayyayv beoto veet beno", divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: shechitat immo metaharto.
b: Rabbi shimon shezuri omer: afillu ben chamesh shanim vechoresh bassade – shechitat immo metaharto. keraah umatza bah ben tisha chay – taun shechita, lefi shello nishchata immo.
Gemara amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: lo hillechu bo ella al iske shechita bilvad. lemaote may? lemaote chelbo vegido.

Chelbo demay? illema: chelbo dishlil, miflag peligi! detanya: gid hannashe noheg bashshelil vechelbo asur, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: eno noheg bashshelil vechelbo muttar. veamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: machloket beven tisha chay, vehalach rabbi meir leshitato, verabbi yehuda leshitato.
Ella, chelbo degid miflag peligi, detanya: gid hannashe – mechattet acharav bechol makom shehu, vechotech shamno meikkaro, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: gommo im hashshofi.
Ella i ittemar – hachi ittemar, amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: lo hillechu bo ella al iske achila bilvad, lemaote rovo, vechoresh bo.
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: ledivre hammattir bechelbo – mattir bedamo, ledivre haoser bechelbo – oser bedamo. verabbi yochanan amar: af ledivre hammattir bechelbo – oser bedamo.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish: koro umotzi et damo. amar rabbi zera: lomar sheen anush karet.
Leman kaamri? lerabbi yehuda, lo yehe ella dam hattamtzit, detanya: dam hattamtzit beazhara, rabbi yehuda omer: behikkaret.

Targema rav yosef bereh derav salla chasida kammeh derav pappa: it leh lerabbi yehuda "dam" vechol dam", kol hecha demichayyayv addam hannefesh – michayyayv addam hattamtzit, vechol hecha dela michayyayv addam hannefesh – la michayyayv addam hattamtzit.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu lifdot beven pekua? allibba derabbi meir la tibbee lach, dechevan deamar taun shechita – se mealleya hu.
Ki tibbee lach allibba derabbanan, deamri: shechitat immo metaharto, may? kevan deamri shechitat immo metaharto – kevisra bedikkula hu, o dilma, kevan derahet veazel verahet veate – "se" karena beh?
Mar zutera amar: en podin, verav ashe amar: podin.
Amar leh rav ashe lemar zutera: may datach? degamrat "se" "se" mippesachim?
I ma lehallan – zachar, tamim, uven shana, af kan – zachar, tamim, uven shana! "tifde" "tifde" ribba.
I "tifde" "tifde" ribba, afillu kol mille name, im ken "se" "se" may ahani lach?
Ibbaya lehu: mahu limnot bo rishon vesheni?
Rabbi yochanan amar: monin bo rishon vesheni. rabbi shimon ben lakish omer: en monin bo rishon vesheni, naasa keegoz hammitkashkesh biklippato.
Etiveh rabbi shimon ben lakish lerabbi yochanan: habbasar magga nevela – divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: magga terefa shechuta.
Bishlama ledidi, deamena chad gufa hu – hayeynu deittachshar bidma deimmeh, ella ledidach, bemay ittachshar?
Amar leh: bishchita, ucherabbi shimon.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish: avar benahar – hucheshar, halach levet hakkevarot – nitma.
Bishlama ledidi deamena tere gufe ninhu, mishshum hachi: hucheshar – in, lo hucheshar – la, ella ledidach deamrat chad gufa hu, ha ittachshar bidma deimmeh!

a: Bishchita yabbishta, udela kerabbi shimon.

Man tanna avar benahar hucheshar, halach levet hakkevarot nitma? amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yose haggelili hi, detanya: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi yose haggelili: metamme tumeat ochalim, vetzarich hechsher. vachachamim omrim: eno metamme tumeat ochalin, mippene shehu chay, vechol shehu chay eno metamme tumeat ochalin.
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yose haggelili uvet shammay amru davar echad.

Rabbi yose haggelili – ha daamaran. bet shammay, ditnan: dagim, meematay mekabbelin tumea? bet shammay omrim: mishsheyyitztzodu, uvet hillel omrim: mishsheyyamutu. rabbi akiva omer: mishshaa sheen yecholin lichyot.
May benayyhu? amar rabbi yochanan: dag mekartea ikka benayyhu.
Bae rav chisda: noldu bedagim simane terefa, mahu? tibbee leman deamar terefa chayya, vetibbee leman deamar terefa enah chayya.

Tibbee leman deamar terefa chayya, behema hu dinfisha chayyuta, aval dagim dela nefisha chayyutayyhu – la, o dilma afillu leman deamar terefa enah chayya, hane mille behema deyesh beminah shechita, aval dagim deen beminan shechita – ema la. teku.
Hetila nefel, rabbi yochanan amar: chelbo kechelev behema, verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: chelbo kechelev chayya.
Rabbi yochanan amar: chelbo kechelev behema – avvera garem. rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: chelbo kechelev chayya – chodashim garmi.

Ikka deamri: kol hecha delo kalu lo chodashav – la kelum hu. ki peligi – hecha dehoshit yado lime behema, vetalash chelev shel ben tisha chay veachal. rabbi yochanan amar: chelbo kechelev behema, chodashim garmi. rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: chelbo kechelev chayya, chodashim veavvera garmi.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish: ma chelev ushete chelayot haamurot beasham – mutza mikkelal shelil, af kol – mutza mikkelal shelil.
Bishlama ledidi, hayeynu deitzterich kera lemaote, ella ledidach, ammay itzterich? amar leh: tama didi name mehacha.
Veikka deamri, etiveh rabbi shimon ben lakish lerabbi yochanan: ma chelev ushete chelayot haamurot beasham mutza mikkelal shelil, af kol – mutza mikkelal shelil.
Bishlama ledidi, mishshum hachi mayateh rachamana, ella ledidach – likrav? amar leh: midde dehave ammechussar zeman.
Amar rabbi amme: hashshochet et hatterefa umatza bah ben tisha chay, ledivre haoser – mattir, ledivre hammattir – oser.
Rava amar: ledivre hammattir name muttar, arbaa simanin achshar beh rachamana.
Amar rav chisda: hashshochet et hatterefa, umatza bah ben tisha chay –
b: Taun shechita, vechayyayv bizroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva, veim met – tahor milletamme bemassa.
Amar leh rava: taun shechita – keman? kerabbi meir, veim met tahor milletamme bemassa – keman? kerabbanan.

Velitamaych, ha detane rabbi chiyyay: hashshochet et hatterefa umatza bah ben tisha chay – taun shechita, vechayyayv bizroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva, veim met – tahor milletamme bemassa. taun shechita keman? kerabbi meir, veim met – tahor milletamme bemassa, kerabbanan.
Ha la kashya, rabbi chiyyay im kevar metzao met kaamar, ella ledidach kashya!
Amar leh: ledidi name la kashya, arbaa simanim achshar beh rachamana.
Ki salek rabbi zera, ashkecheh lerav assi deyatev vekaamar leh leha shemata. amar leh: yishar, vechen amar rabbi yochanan. mikkelal diflig aleh rabbi shimon ben lakish?
Mishha hava shahe leh veshatek leh, veikka deamri: mishta hava shate veshatek leh.
Rabbi shimon shezuri omer: afillu vechulei. hayeynu tanna kamma! amar rav kahana: hifris al gabbe karka ikka benayyhu.
Amar rav mesharsheya: ledivre haomer choshshin lezera haav, ben pekua habba al behema meallayyta – havvalad en lo takkana.

Amar abbaye: hakkol modim bekalut ben pekua shemmuttar, may tama? kol milleta ditmiha midkar dechiri la inashe. ikka deamri: amar abbaye: hakkol modim bekalut ben keluta ben pekua shemmuttar, may tama? tere temihe midkar dechiri inashe.
Amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina: halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri, vechen haya rabbi shimon shezuri mattir bivno uven beno ad sof kol haddorot. rabbi yochanan amar: hu muttar, uveno asur.

Adda bar chavu hava leh ben pekua dinfal deva aleh, ata lekammeh derav ashe. amar leh: zil shachteh. amar leh: haamar zeeri amar rabbi chanina: halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri, vechen haya rabbi shimon shezuri mattir bivno uven beno ad sof kol haddorot, vaafillu rabbi yochanan la kaamar ella beno, aval ihu la!
Amar leh: rabbi yochanan ledivre rabbi shimon shezuri kaamar.
Vehaamar ravin bar chanina amar ulla amar rabbi chanina: halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri, velo od, ella kol makom sheshshana rabbi shimon shezuri bemishnatenu – halacha kemoto!
Amar leh: ana ki ha sevira li, deamar rabbi yonatan: halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri bimsukkan, uvitrumat maaser shel demay.

Mesukkan, ditnan: barishona hayu omrim, hayyotze bekolar veamar: "kitvu get leishti", hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. chazru lomar: af hamefaresh vehayyotze bishyayra. rabbi shimon ben shezuri omer: af hamesukkan.
Terumat maaser shel demay, ditnan: terumat maaser shel demay shechazra limkomah, rabbi shimon ben shezuri omer: af bachol shoalo veochlo al piv.

a: Mishna behema shennechtechu ragleha min haarkubba ulematta – keshera, min haarkubba ulemala – pesula, vechen shennittal tzomet haggidin.
Nishbar haetzem, im rov habbasar kayyaym – shechitato metaharto, veim lav – en shechitato metaharto.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav amar rabbi chiyyay: lematta – lematta min haarkubba, lemala – lemala min haarkubba. beezo arkubba amru? bearkubba hannimkeret im harosh.
Ulla amar rabbi oshaya: kenegdo begamal nikkar.
Amar leh ulla lerav yehuda: bishlama ledidi deamena kenegdo begamal nikkar, hayeynu dekatane: vechen shennittal tzomet haggidin, ella ledidach, may vechen shennittal tzomet haggidin?
Amar leh: rechubba belo tzomet haggidim, vetzomet haggidim belo rechubba. veha "nechtechu" katane! ishtik.
Levatar dinfak amar: may tama la amari leh, "lematta" – lematta min haarkubba, "lemala" – lemala mitztzomet haggidin?
Hadar amar: vela amari leh, vaamar li: "nechtechu" katane? hacha name, "min haarkubba ulemala" katane.

Rav pappa matne hachi: amar rav yehuda amar rav amar rabbi chiyyay: "lematta" – lematta min haarkubba umitztzomet haggidin, "lemala" – lemala min haarkubba umitztzomet haggidin, vechen shennittal tzomet haggidin. vearkubba gufa kidulla amar rabbi oshaya.
Umi ikka midde, deillu middele pasek leh vachaya, metatte pasek leh umeta?
Amar rav ashe: terefot ka medammet lahadade? en omrin bitrefot zo doma lazo, shehare chotchah mikkan vameta, chotchah mikkan vechayya.
Veellu hen tzomet haggidin? rabba amar rav ashe: deaggarma ulevar, rabba bar rav huna amar rav ashe: deaggarma ulegav, rava bereh derabba bar rav huna amar rav assi: deillave arkuma.

Yatev hahu merabbanan kammeh derabbi abba, veyatev vekaamar: dearkuma gufa. amar leh rabbi abba: la tetzitu leh, hachi amar rav yehuda: hecha defari tabbache. vehayeynu rava bereh derabba bar rav huna amar rav assi.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: tzomet haggidim sheamru – mekom shehaggidin tzomtin, vead kamma? amar leh hahu midderabbanan, verav yaakov shemeh: ki havenan be rav yehuda amar lan: shemau manni milleta demiggavra rabba shemia li, umannu? shemuel: tzomet haggidin sheamru – mekom shehaggidin tzomtin bo, umimmekom shetztzomtin ad mekom shemmitpashshetin.
Vechamma? amar abbaye: arbaa batde betora. bedakka may? amar abbaye: beliti – havu tzomet haggidim, belii – la havu tzomet haggidim.

Ashshune – havu tzomet haggidim, rakkiche – la havu tzomet haggidim, allime – havu tzomet haggidim, kattine – la havu tzomet haggidim, chivvavre – havu tzomet haggidim, la chivvavre – la havu tzomet haggidim.
b: Mar bar rav ashe amar: kevan dezigi – af al gav dela chivvavre.

Amar ammemar mishshemeh derav zevid: telata chute havu, chad allima utere kattine. ippesik allima – azda rov binyan, ippesik kattine – azda rov minyan. mar bar rav ashe matne lekulla: ippesik allima – haikka rov minyan, ippesik kattine – haikka rov binyan.

Beofot shittesar chute havu, ippesik chad minnayyhu – terefa. amar mar bar rav ashe: hava kaemna kammeh deabba, veayyto lekammeh ofa, uvedak veashkach beh chamesar. hava chad dahava shane mechavreh, nappetzeh veashkach tere.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: tzomet haggidin sheamru berubbo; may rubbo? rov echad mehen. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: mikkede telata havu, ki mippesik chad minnayyhu ligmare, ha ikka tere.
Tama deikka tere, ha lekka tere – la, ufeliga deravnay, deamar ravnay amar shemuel: tzomet haggidim, afillu lo nishtayyer bah ella kechut hassarbal – keshera.

Veikka deamri: may rubbo? rov kol echad veechad. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: mikkede telata havu, haikka telata dechol chad vechad mesayyay leh leravnay, deamar ravnay amar shemuel: tzomet haggidin sheamru, afillu lo nishtayyer bah ella kechut hassarbal – keshera.
Nishbar haetzem kulei.

Amar rav: lemala min haarkubba, im rov habbasar kayyaym – ze vaze muttar, veim lav – ze vaze asur. lematta min haarkubba, im rov habbasar kayyaym – ze vaze muttar, im lav – ever asur uvehema mutteret.
Ushemuel amar: ben lemala ben lematta, im rov habbasar kayyaym – ze vaze muttar, im lav – ever asur, uvehema mutteret.
Matkef la rav nachman lishmuel: yomru "ever mimmenna muttal baashpa umutteret"? amar leh rav acha bar rav huna lerav nachman: lerav name yomru "ever mimmenna muttal baashpa umutteret"!
Amar leh: hachi kaamena, ever shechaya mimmenna muttal baashpa, umutteret?
Shelachu mittam: hilcheta kevavteh derav, hadur shelachu: kevavteh dishmuel, hadur shelachu: kevavteh derav, veever atzmo metamme bemassa.
Metiv rav chisda: lo, im tihara shechitat terefa otah veet haever hameduledal bah – davar sheggufah, tetaher et haubbar – davar sheeno gufah?
Amar leh rabba: haddore appirche lema lach? otev mimmatnitin! nishchata behema – hucheshru bedameha, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon omer: lo hucheshru.
Amar leh: matnitin ikka ledachoye, kiddachenan.

Ki salek rabbi zera, ashkecheh lerav yirmeya deyatev vekaamar la leha shemata. amar leh: yishar, vechen targema aryoch bevavel. aryoch mannu? shemuel. veha miflag pelig! hadar beh shemuel legabbeh derav.

Tanu rabbanan: nishbar haetzem veyatza lachutz, im or uvasar chofin et rubbo – muttar, im lav – asur. vechamma rubbo? ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: rov ovyo, veamri la: rov hekkefo. amar rav pappa: hilkach, baenan rov ovyo uvaenan rov hekkefo.
Amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: or hare hu kevasar. amar leh rav nachman leulla: velema mar or metzaref levasar, deha "or uvasar" katane! amar leh: anan "or o basar" tanenan.
Ikka deamri [amar ulla], amar rabbi yochanan: or mitztaref levasar. amar leh rav nachman leulla: velema mar or mashlim levasar lechumera!

Amar leh: ana ovada yadana, dehahu bar gozala dahava be rabbi yitzchak, deor metzaref levasar hava, vaata lekammeh derabbi yochanan veachshereh. amar leh: bar gozala kaamrat? bar gozala derakkich shane.
Hanhu gidin rakkin daato lekammeh derabba, amar rabba: lemay lechush lehu? chada, deamar rabbi yochanan: gidin shessofan lehakeshot

a: Nimnin alehen bappesach, veod, hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael.
Amar leh rav pappa lerabba: rabbi shimon ben lakish, veissura deorayyta, veat amrat: may lechush lehu?! ishtik.
Veammay ishtik? vehaamar rava: hilcheta kevavteh derabbi shimon ben lakish behane telat!
Shane hacha, dahadar beh rabbi yochanan legabbeh derabbi shimon ben lakish, daamar leh: al takniteni, bilshon yachid ani shone otah.
Hahu nishbar haetzem veyatza lachutz, deishtekil kuretita minneh, ata lekammeh deabbaye, shahayeh telata rigle.
Amar leh rav adda bar matna: zil kammeh derava bereh derav yosef bar chama, dacharifa sakkineh. ata lekammeh, amar: mikkede "nishbar haetzem veyatza lachutz" tenan, ma li nefal, ma li iteh?
Amar leh ravina lerava: mitlakket mahu? mitroses mahu? mitmasmes mahu? hechi dame mitmasmes? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: kol sheharofe kodro.
Ibbaya lehu: nikkav mahu? niklaf mahu? nisdak mahu? nittal shelish hattachton mahu?
Ta shema, deamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: or hare hu kevasar, dilma dikna mashka dideh.

Amar rav ashe: ki havenan be rav pappe, ibbaya lan: nikdar kemin tabbaat, mahu? ufeshatna meha deamar rav yehuda amar rav: davar ze shaalti lachachamim velarofim, veamru: mesarto beetzem umaale arucha, aval parzela mizraf zaref. amar rav pappa: vehu dikna garma dideh.
Mishna hashshochet et habbehema umatza bah shilya – nefesh hayyafe tochlenna, veenah metammea lo tumeat ochalin velo tumeat nevelot. chishshev aleha – metammea tumeat ochalin, aval lo tumeat nevelot.
Shilya sheyyatzta miktzatah – asura baachila, siman valad baishsha vesiman valad babbehema.
Hamevakkeret shehippila shilya – yashlichenna lichlavim, uvammukedashin tikkaver, veen kovrin otah befarashat derachim, veen tolin otah beilan, mippene darche haemori.
Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "kol (behema) [babbehema] tochelu" – lerabbot et hashshilya. yachol afillu yatzta miktzatah? talmud lomar: "otah" – otah velo shilyatah.
Mikkedi en shilya belo valad, lema li kera? kera asmachta bealma.
Veenah metammea. bae rabbi yitzchak bar nappacha: or chamor sheshshelako mahu? lemay? i letumeat ochalin – tenena,
b: I letumeat nevelot – tenena.
Tumeat ochalin, detanya: haor vehashshilya – en mittammein tumeat ochalin, or sheshshelako, vehashshilya shechishshev aleha – metammein tumeat ochalin.
Tumeat nevelot name tenena: "benivlatah" – velo baor, velo beatzmotav, velo baggidin, velo bakkarnayim, velo battelafayim.
Veamar rabba bar rav chana: lo nitzrecha ella sheasaan tzike kedera.
Leolam tumeat ochalin, veshane or chamor dimis.

Shilya sheyyatzta. amar rabbi elazar: lo shanu ella sheen immah valad, aval yesh immah valad – en choshshin levalad acher. verabbi yochanan amar: ben en immah valad ben yesh immah valad – choshshin levalad acher.
Ini? veha amar rabbi yirmeya: lechumera amra rabbi elazar!
Ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar, amar rabbi elazar: lo shanu ella sheenah keshura bavvalad, aval keshura bavvalad – en choshshin levalad acher.

Verabbi yochanan amar: anu en lanu ella shilya belo valad, aval yesh immah valad, ben keshura bavvalad ben en keshura bavvalad – en choshshin levalad acher, vehayeynu deamar rabbi yirmeya: lechumera amra Rabbi elazar.

Tanya kevavteh derabbi elazar: hammappelet min behema chayya vaof, veshilya immahen, bizman shekkeshura bahen – en choshshin levalad acher, enah keshura bahen – hareni metil aleha chomer shene veladot.
Sheani omar: shemma nimmoach shafir shel shilya, shemma nimmocha shilyato shel shafir.
Hamevakkeret shehippila. may tama? amar rav ika bereh derav amme: rov behemot yoldot davar hakkadosh bivchora, umiut behemot davar sheeno kadosh bivchora, umay nihu? nidme.
Vechol hayyoldot yoldot mechetza zecharim umechetza nekevot, semoch miuta denidme lemechetza dinkevot, vehavu lehu zecharim miuta.
Uvammukedashin tikkaver. may tama? rubba bar mikdash hu.
Veen kovrim otah. abbaye verava deamri tarvavyyhu: kol davar sheyyesh bo refua – en bo mishshum darche haemori, en bo refua – yesh bo mishshum darche haemori.
Vehatanya: ilan shemmashshir perotav, sokro besikra vetoano baavanim. bishlama toano baavanim – ki hechi

a: Denichchosh cheleh, ella sokro besikra ammay? ki hechi delichzeyu inashe velivuy rachame illaveh.
Kidtanya: "vetame tame yikra" – tzarich lehodia larabbim, verabbim mevakkeshim alav rachamim. vechen mi sheera bo davar – tzarich lehodia larabbim, verabbim mevakkeshim alav rachamim.
Amar ravina: keman talenan kuvesa bedikla, keman? ki hay tanna.
Hadaran alach behema hamekashsha.
Mishna oto veet beno noheg ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit, bechullin uvemukedashin.
Ketzad? hashshochet oto veet beno, chullin bachutz – shenehem kesherim, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim.
Kadashim bachutz – harishon chayyayv karet, ushenehem pesulim, ushenehem sofgim et haarbaim.
Chullin bifnim – shenehem pesulin, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim; kadashim bifnim – harishon kasher ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul.
Chullin vekadashim bachutz – harishon kasher, ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim, ufasul.
Kadashim vechullin bachutz – harishon chayyayv karet ufasul, vehashsheni kasher, ushenehem sofgim et haarbaim.
Chullin vekadashim bifnim – shenehem pesulin, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim. kadashim vechullin bifnim – harishon kasher ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul.
Chullin bachutz uvifnim – harishon kasher, ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim, ufasul.
Kadashim bachutz uvifnim – harishon chayyayv karet, ushenehem sofgim et haarbaim, ushenehem pesulim.
Chullin bifnim uvachutz – harishon pasul, ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim, vechasher. kadashim bifnim uvachutz – harishon kasher, ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim, ufasul.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: minnayin leoto veet beno shennoheg bemukedashin? talmud lomar: "shor o chesev o ez ki yivvaled", uchetiv batreh: "veshor o se oto veet beno lo tishchatu beyom echad" – limmed al oto veet beno shennoheg bemukedashin.
Veema: bemukedashin – in, bechullin – la! "shor" hifsik hainyan.
Veema: bechullin – in, bemukedashin – la! ketiv: "veshor" – vav mosif al inyan rishon.
I ma kadashim kilayim la, af oto veet beno kilayim la? allema tanya: oto veet beno noheg bechilayim uvechoy?
Veod, "se" ketiv, veamar rava:
b: Ze bana av – kol makom shenneemar "se" eno ella lehotzi et hakkilayim. amar kera "o" lerabbot et hakkilayim.
Hay "o" mibbee leh lechallek, desalka datach amena: ad deshachet shor uveno se uveno la michayyayv, ka mashma lan. lechallek – mibbeno" nafka.
Veakkatti mibbee leh lechidtanya: illu neemar "shor vase uveno", hayiti omer: ad sheyyishchot shor vase uveno, talmud lomar: "shor o se oto veet beno". may lav meo" nafka leh? la, meoto".
Hanicha lerabbanan, dimyaytar lehu "oto", ella lachananya, dela meyaytar leh "oto", lechallek mena leh? lechallek la tzerich kera, desavar la kerabbi yonatan.

Detanya: "ish asher yekallel et aviv veet immo", en li ella aviv veimmo, aviv shello immo veimmo shello aviv minnayin? talmud lomar: "aviv veimmo killel" – aviv killel, immo killel, divre rabbi yoshiyya.
Rabbi yonatan omer: mashma shenehem keechad, umashma echad bifne atzmo, ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv "yachdav".
May chananya, umay rabbanan? detanya: oto veet beno noheg binkevot, veeno noheg bizcharim. chananya omer: noheg ben bizcharim uven binkevot.

May tama derabbanan? detanya: yachol yehe oto veet beno noheg ben bizcharim uven binkevot? vedin hu: chiyyev kan, vechayyayv beem al habbanim; ma keshechiyyev beem al habbanim – binkevot velo bizcharim, af keshechiyyev kan – binkevot velo bizcharim.
Lo, im amarta beem al habbanim, shekken lo asa bah mezumman kesheeno mezumman, tomar beoto veet beno, sheasa bo mezumman kesheeno mezumman?

Talmud lomar: "oto" – echad velo shenayim. achar shechillek hakkatuv, zachiti ledin: chiyyev kan vechiyyev beem al habbanim – ma keshechiyyev beem al habbanim – binkevot velo bizcharim, af keshechiyyev kan – binkevot velo bizcharim.
Veim nafshecha lomar, "beno" – mi shebbeno karuch acharav, yatza zachar sheen beno karuch acharav.
Ma im nafshecha lomar? vechi tema "oto" zachar mashma, hare hu omer "beno" – mi shebbeno karuch acharav, yatza zachar sheen beno karuch acharav.

a: Velachananya, ketiv "oto" demashma zachar, uchetiv "beno" – mi shebbeno karuch acharav demashma nekeva, hilkach noheg ben bizcharim ben binkevot.

Amar rav huna bar chiyyay amar shemuel: hilcheta kachananya, veazda shemuel letameh, ditnan: rabbi yehuda omer: hannoladim min hassus, af al pi sheavihen chamor – muttarin ze beze, aval hannoladin min hachamor im hannoladin min hassus – asurin.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: zo divre rabbi yehuda, deamar en choshshin lezera haav, aval chachamim omrim: kol mine peradot achat hen.
Man chachamim? chananya hu, deamar choshshin lezera haav, vehay bar suseya vachamara, vehay bar chamara vesuseya – kullehu chada mina ninhu.
Ibbaya lehu: mi peshit leh lerabbi yehuda deen choshshin lezera haav, o dilma sappoke mesappeka leh? lemay nafka minna?
Lemishre peri im haem, i amrat: mifshat peshita leh – peri im haem shere, ella i amrat: sappoke mesappeka leh – peri im haem asur.

May ta shema: rabbi yehuda omer: kol hannoladim min hassus, af al pi sheavihen chamor – muttarin ze baze. hechi dame? illema daavu dehay chamor vaavu dehay chamor – tzericha lememar? ella lav daavu dehay sus vaavu dehay chamor;
Vekatane muttarim ze im ze, alma mifshat peshita leh!
La, leolam daavu dehay chamor, vaavu dehay chamor. udekaamrat: tzericha lememar? mahu detema: ate tzad desus mishtammesh betzad chamor, vetzad chamor mishtammesh betzad sus, ka mashma lan.
Ta shema: rabbi yehuda omer, pirda shettava – en marbiin aleha lo sus velo chamor, ella minah. vei amrat mifshat peshita leh larba ala mina deimma! dela yadinan mina deimma may nihu.

Veha "ella minna" katane? hachi kaamar: en marbiin aleha lo min sus velo min chamor, lefi sheen yodin beminah. velivdok besimanin? deamar abbaye: ave kaleh – bar chammara, tzenif kaleh – bar suseya. veamar rav pappa: ravrevan udeneh vezutera genuveteh – bar chammara, zuteran udeneh verabba genuveteh – bar suseya. hacha bemay askinan? beillemet vegiddemet.
May have ala? ta shema, deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hakkol modin bifri im haem sheasur. shema minna sappoke mesappeka leh, shema minna.
Amar leh rabbi abba leshammaeh: i meayyeylat li kudanyayta berispak, ayyen lehanach dedamyayn lahadade, veayyel li. alma kasavar: en choshshin lezera haav.
b: Vesimanin deorayyta.

Tanu rabbanan: oto veet beno noheg bechilayim uvechoy. rabbi eliezer omer: kilayim habba min haez umin harachel – oto veet beno noheg bo, koy – en oto veet beno noheg bo. amar rav chisda: ezehu koy shennechleku bo rabbi eliezer vachachamim? ze habba min hattayish umin hatztzeviyyay.

Hechi dame? illema betayish habba al hatztzeviyyay, veyalda, veka shachet la velivra – vehaamar rav chisda: hakkol modim behi tzeviyyay uvenah tayish, sheppatur! se uveno amar rachamana, velo tzevi uveno!
Ella bitzvi habba al hatteyaysha veyalda, veka shachet la velivra, vehaamar rav chisda: hakkol modim behi teyaysha uvenah tzevi – shechayyayv, "se" amar rachamana, uveno kol dehu!
Leolam, betayish habba al hatztzeviyyay, veyalda bat, uvat yalda ben, veka shachet la velivra.
Rabbanan savri: choshshin lezera haav, vese – vaafillu miktzat se. verabbi eliezer savar: en choshshin lezera haav, vese vaafillu miktzat se" – la amrinan.
Veliflog bechoshshin lezera haav, biflugeta dachananya verabbanan?
I peligi behahi, hava amena: beha afillu rabbanan modu, dese vaafillu miktzat se" la amrinan, ka mashma lan.
Veha ditnan: koy en shochatin oto beyom tov, veim shechato – en mechassin et damo.
Bemay askinan? ilema betayish habba al hatztzeviyyay veyalda, ben lerabbanan ben lerabbi eliezer – lishchot velichasse, tzevi vaafillu miktzat tzevi.
Ella bitzvi habba al hatteyaysha veyalda, i lerabbanan – lishchot velichasse, i lerabbi eliezer – lishchot vela lichasse.
Leolam bitzvi habba al hatteyaysha, verabbanan sappoke mesappeka lehu i choshshin lezera haav i en choshshin.
Umiddilrabbanan mesappeka lehu, lerabbi eliezer peshita leh.
Veha detanya: hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva nohagim bechoy uvechilayim. rabbi eliezer omer: kilayim habba min haez umin harachel – chayyayv bemattanot, min hakkoy – patur min hammattanot.
Bemay askinan? ilema betayish habba al hatztzeviyyay veyalda, bishlama lerabbi eliezer defatar, kasavar "se vaafillu miktzat se" la amrinan.
Ella lerabbanan, nehi dekasavri "se vaafillu miktzat se", bishlama palga la yahev leh, iddach palga lema leh: ayyti reayay dechoshshin lezera haav, ushekol.
Ella, bitzvi habba al hatteyaysha veyalda. bishlama lerabbanan, may "chayyayv" – bachatzi mattanot; ella lerabbi eliezer, lichayyayv bechullehi mattanot?
Leolam bitzvi habba al hatteyaysha veyalda, verabbi eliezer name sappoke mesappeka leh i choshshin lezera haav o la, vechevan dilrabbanan mesappeka lehu ulerabbi eliezer mesappeka leh, bemay peligi?

a: Bese vaafillu miktzat se, rabbanan savri: "se" – vaafillu miktzat se, verabbi eliezer savar: "se" – velo miktzat se.
Amar rav pappa: hilkach, leinyan kissuy haddam umattanot, la mashkachat ella bitzvi habba al hatteyaysha.
Deven lerabbanan, uven lerabbi eliezer, mesappeka lehu i choshshin lezera haav o la.
Veka mippalgi bese vaafillu miktzat se".
Leinyan oto veet beno, mashkachat la ben betayish habba al hatztzeviyyay, uven bitzvi habba al hatteyaysha.
Betayish habba al hatztzeviyyay, uleissura derabbanan savri: dilma choshshin lezera haav, "se vaafillu miktzat se" amrinan, veasur.
Verabbi eliezer savar: nehi name dechoshshin lezera haav, "se vaafillu miktzat se" la amrinan.
Bitzvi habba al hatteyaysha, ulemalkut. rabbanan savri: nehi name dechoshshin lezera haav, "se vaafillu miktzat se" amrinan, umalkenan leh. verabbi eliezer savar: issura ikka, malkut lekka.
Issura ikka, dilma en choshshin lezera haav, vehay se mealleya hu. malkut lekka, dilma choshshin lezera haav.
Vese vaafillu miktzat se" la amrinan.
Amar rav yehuda: koy – beriyya bifne atzmah hi, velo hichriu bah chachamim im min behema hi im min chayya hi. rav nachman amar: koy – ze el habbar.

Ketannae: koy – ze ayil habbar, veyesh omrim: ze habba min hattayish umin hatztzeviyyay. rabbi yose omer: koy beriyya bifne atzmah hi, velo hichriu bah chachamim im min chayya im min behema. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: min behema hi, veshel bet dushay hayu megaddelin mehen adarim adarim.
Amar rabbi zera amar rav safra amar rav hamenuna: hane izze devala kesherot legabbe mizbeach, savar la ki ha deamar rabbi yitzchak: eser behemot mana hakkatuv, vetu la.
Vehane middela kachashev lehu bahade chayyot – shema minna deez ninhu. matkef la rav acha bar yaakov: veema "ayyal utzevi" – parat, "kol behema" – kalal.
Parat vechalal – naase kelal musaf al happerat, ikka tuva.
Im ken, kol hane perate lema li? matkef la rav acha bereh derav ika: vedilma mina deakko ninhu!
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe, veamri la rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: dilma mina dito o mina dezemer ninhu? amar leh rav chanan lerav ashe: ammemar share tarbayyhu.
Bea minneh abba bereh derav minyamin bar chiyyay merav huna bar chiyyay: hane izze devala mahu legabbe mizbeach? amar leh: ad kan la peligi rabbi yose verabbanan ella beshor habbar.

Ditnan: shor habbar min behema hu, rabbi yose omer: min chayya. derabbanan savri: middimtargeminan "torbala", mina divhema hu, verabbi yose savar: middeka chashev leh bahade chayyot, mina dechayya hu. aval hane, divre hakkol mina deez ninhu.
Matkef la rav acha bereh derav ika: vedilma mina deakko ninhu! amar leh ravina lerav ashe: vedilma mina detao, o mina dezemer ninhu! amar leh rav nachman lerav ashe: ammemar share tarbayyhu.

Ketzad hashshochet vechulei. amar rabbi oshaya: kulla matnitin dela kerabbi shimon, mimmay? middeka tane: kadashim bachutz harishon chayyayv karet, ushenehem pesulim, ushenehem sofgim et haarbaim. mikkedi shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar: shechita sheenah reuya – lo shemah shechita,
b: Kamma miktal katleh, sheni mitkabbel bifnim hu, karet name lichayyayv.

Chullin bifnim – shenehem pesulin, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim. mikkede shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar: shechita sheenah reuya – lo shemah shechita, kamma miktal katleh, sheni ammay sofeg et haarbaim?
Kadashim bifnim – harishon kasher ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim, ufasul.

Mikkede shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar: shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita, shechitat kodashim name shechita sheenah reuya hi, dechamma dela zarek dam – la mishtere basar. sheni ammay sofeg et haarbaim, ufasul? ella shema minna dela kerabbi shimon.

Peshita dehachi ita? shechitat kadashim itztericha leh, salka datach amena: shechitat kadashim shechita reuya hi, deha i nachar vezarek dam – la mishtere basar, vechi shachat – mishtere basar, ushechita reuya hi; ka mashma lan.
Velilke name mishshum lav dimchussar zeman, detanya: minnayin lechol happesulin shebbashshor veshebbasse shehu belo yeratze"?
Talmud lomar: "veshor vase sarua vekalut vegomer", limmed al happesulin shebbashshor veshebbasse, shehu belo yeratze"!
Ki ka chashev lave deoto veet beno" – lave nucherae la ka chashev.
Vela? veha kadashim bachutz, delave nucherae ninhu, veka chashev, dekatane: kadashim bachutz – harishon chayyayv karet, ushenehem sofgin et haarbaim.
Bishlama sheni, mishshum lav deoto veet beno", ella rishon ammay sofeg? lav mishshum lav dishchute chutz?
Kol hecha delekka lav deoto veet beno" – chashev lave nucherae, vechol hecha deikka lav deoto veet beno" – la chashev lave nucherae.
Rabbi zera amar: hannach limchussar zeman, dehakkatuv

a: Nitteko laase. may tama? deamar kera: "miyyom hashshemini vahala yeratze" – miyyom hashemini in, meikkara la. lav habba mikkelal ase – ase.

Veha mibbaya leh lechidrabbi aftoriki, derabbi aftoriki rame: ketiv "vehaya shivat yamim tachat immo", ha layla chaze, uchetiv "miyyom hashshemini vahala yeratze" – miyyom hashshemini vahala in, layla la!
Ha ketzad? layla likdushsha, yom leharetzaa. ketiv kera acharina: "ken taase leshorcha letzonecha".

Amar rav hamenuna: omer haya rabbi shimon: en oto veet beno noheg bekodashim, may tama? kevan deamar rabbi shimon: shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita, shechitat kodashim name shechita sheenah reuya hi.

Metiv rava: oto veet beno kadashim bachutz, rabbi shimon omer: sheni belo taase, shehaya rabbi shimon omer: kol harauy lavo leachar zeman – hare hu belo taase veen bo karet, vachachamim omrim: kol sheen bo karet – eno belo taase.
Vekashya lan: kadashim bachutz, sheni belo taase? kamma miktal ketal, sheni mitkabbel bifnim hu, karet name lichayyayv!
Veamar rava, veamri la kedi: chassore michassera vehachi katane: kadashim shenehem bachutz, lerabbanan – rishon anush karet, sheni pasul ufatur millav dishchute chutz.
Lerabbi shimon – shenehem anushim karet.
Echad bachutz veechad bifnim: lerabbanan – rishon anush karet, sheni pasul ufatur; lerabbi shimon – sheni kasher.
Echad bifnim veechad bachutz: lerabbanan – rishon kasher ufatur, sheni pasul ufatur, lerabbi shimon – sheni belo taase.
Vei salka datach en "oto veet beno" noheg bekadashim, sheni ammay belo taase vetu la? karet name lichayyayv!
Ella amar rava, hachi ka amar rav hamenuna: en malkot "oto veet beno" noheg bekadashim,
Kevan dechamma dela zarek dam – la mishtere basar, meiddana deka shachet havey hateraat safek, vehateraat safek – lo shemah hateraa.
Veazda rava letameh, deamar rava: hi chullin uvenah shelamim, shachat chullin veachar kach shachat shelamim – patur.
Shelamim veachar kach chullin – chayyayv, veamar rava: hi chullin uvenah ola, la mibbaya shachat chullin veachar kach shachat ola defatur,
b: Ella afillu shachat ola veachar kach shachat chullin – patur, shechita kammayyta lav shechita bat achila hi.
Verabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: achilat mizbeach shemah achila. may tama? deamar kera: "veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav".
Bishte achilot hakkatuv medabber, echad achilat adam veechad achilat mizbeach.
Mishna hashshochet venimtza terefa, hashshochet laavoda zara, vehashshochet parat chattat, veshor hanniskal, veegla arufa – rabbi shimon poter, vachachamim mechayyeyvin.
Hashshochet venitnabbela beyado, vehannocher, vehameakker – patur mishshum "oto veet beno".
Gemara amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: lo shanu ella sheshshachat rishon laavoda zara vesheni leshulchano, aval rishon leshulchano vesheni laavoda zara – patur, dekam leh bidrabba minneh.
Amar leh rabbi yochanan: zo, afillu tinokot shel bet rabban yodin otah! ella, peamim sheafillu shachat rishon leshulchano vesheni laavoda zara – chayyayv.
Kegon deatro beh mishshum "oto veet beno", velo atro beh mishshum avoda zara. verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: kevan dechi atro beh – patur, ki la atro beh name – patur.
Veazdu letamayyhu, dechi ata rav dimi amar: chayyayve mitot shoggin, vechayyayve malkot shoggin, vedavar acher – rabbi yochanan omer: chayyayv, veresh lakish omer: patur.
Rabbi yochanan omer: chayyayv, deha la atro beh; veresh lakish omer: patur, dechevan dechi atro beh patur – ki la atro beh name patur.
Utzericha, dei ashmoinan beha – beha kaamar rabbi shimon ben lakish, aval beha – ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan.
Vei ittemar beha, beha kaamar rabbi yochanan, aval beha ema mode lerabbi shimon ben lakish, tzericha.
Ufarat chattat shechita sheenah reuya hi? vehatanya: rabbi shimon omer: para metammea tumeat ochalin, hoil vehayta lah sheat hakkosher.

a: Veamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: omer haya rabbi shimon, para nifdet al gabbe maarachtah. amar rav shemen bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: parat chattat enah mishna.
Veegla arufa, lav shechita reuya hi? vehatnan: nimtza hahoreg ad shello tearef haagala – tetze vetire baeder. amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum rabbi yannay: egla arufa enah mishna.
Umi amar rabbi yannay hachi? vehaamar rabbi yannay: gevul shamati bah, veshachachti, venasvin chavrayya lomar: yeridatah lenachal etan osartah.
Veim ita, lishanne: kan kodem yerida, kan leachar yerida.

Amar rav pinchas bereh derav amme: anan mishshemeh derabbi shimon ben lakish matnenan la, egla arufa enah mishna. amar rav ashe: ki havenan be rav pappe kashya lan, mi amar rabbi shimon ben lakish hachi?
Veha ittemar, tzippore metzora meematay neesarin? rabbi yochanan amar: mishsheat shechita, verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: mishsheat lekicha, veamrinan: may tama derabbi shimon ben lakish?
Gamar "kicha" "kicha" meegla arufa.
Ella amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: egla arufa enah mishna.
Mishna shenayim shellakchu para uvenah, eze shellakach rishon yishchot rishon, veim kadam hashsheni – zacha.
Gemara amar rav yosef: leinyan dina tenan, tena: im kadam hashsheni – hare ze zariz veniskar, zariz – dela avad issura, veniskar – dekaachel bisra.
Mishna shachat para veachar kach shene baneha – sofeg shemonim, shachat shene baneha veachar kach shechatah – sofeg et haarbaim, shechatah veet bittah veet bat bittah – sofeg shemonim.
Shechatah veet bat bittah, veachar kach shachat bittah – sofeg et haarbaim. somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir: sofeg shemonim.
Gemara ammay? "oto veet beno" amar rachamana, velo beno veoto! la salka datach, detanya: "oto veet beno" – en li ella oto veet beno, oto veet immo minnayin?
Keshehu omer "lo tishchatu" – hare kan shenayim, ha ketzad? echad hashshochet et happara, veechad hashshochet et immah, veechad hashshochet et benah – shenayim haacharonim chayyayvin.
b: Hay mibbee leh legufeh? im ken, lichtov "lo tishchot", may "lo tishchatu"?
Veakkatti mibbee leh, dei ketav rachamana "lo tishchot" hava amena: chad – in, tere – la.
Ketav rachamana "lo tishchatu", vaafillu tere! im ken, lichtov "lo yishchatu"!
May "lo tishchatu"? shema minna tarte.
Shechatah veet bat bittah, amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: may tama desomchos?
Ka savar somchos: achal shene zete chelev behelem echad – chayyayv shete chattaot.
Uvedin hu delayshmeinan bealma, vehay deka mashma lan beha, lehodiacha kochan derabbanan, deaf al gav degufin muchelakin – patri rabbanan.

O dilma kasavar somchos: achal shene zete chelev behelem echad eno chayyayv ella achat, vehacha hayeynu tama – hoil vegufin muchelakin? amar leh: in, kasavar achal shene zete chelev behelem echad chayyayv shete chattaot.
Mimmay? midditnan: hazzorea kilayim kilayim loke. may loke? illema loke achat – peshita! veod, may kilayim kilayim? ella peshita shete malkiyyot.

Bemay askinan? ilema beze achar ze uvishte hateraot – tenena: nazir shehaya shote yayin kol hayyom eno chayyayv ella achat, amru lo: 'al tishte!' vehu shote, 'al tishte!' vehu shote – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. ella peshita bevat achat uvehatraa achat.
Manni? illema rabbanan difligi aleh desomchos – hasheta, uma hatam degufin muchelakin patri rabbanan, hacha lo kol shekken?
Ella lav somchos hi? la, leolam rabbanan, umilleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan deikka tere gavvne kilayim.
Uleappoke midderabbi yoshiyya, deamar rabbi yoshiyya: ad sheyyizra chitta useora vechartzan bemappolet yad, ka mashma lan dechi zara chitta vechartzan useora vechartzan name michayyayv.

Ta shema: achal mizze kezayit umizze kezayit – sofeg shemonim. rabbi yehuda omer: eno sofeg ella arbaim. hechi dame? illema beze achar ze uvishte hateraot – may tama derabbi yehuda? hateraat safek hi, veshaminan leh lerabbi yehuda deamar: hateraat safek lo shemah hateraa.
Detanya: hikka et ze vechazar vehikka et ze, killel et ze vechazar vekillel et ze, o shehikka shenehem bevat achat, o shekkillel shenehem bevat achat – chayyayv.
Rabbi yehuda omer: bevat achat – chayyayv, beze achar ze – patur. ella peshita bevat achat uvehatraa achat.
Uman tanna kamma? ilema rabbanan difligi aleh desomchos – hasheta, uma hatam degufin muchelakin patri rabbanan, hacha lo kol shekken? ella lav somchos hi!
La, leolam beze achar ze, verabbanan, vehay tanna savar la keiddach tanna derabbi yehuda.
Deamar: hateraat safek shemah hateraa, detanya: "lo totiru mimmennu ad boker vehannotar mimmennu ad boker baesh tisrofu" –

a: Ba hakkatuv litten ase achar lo taase, lomar sheen lokin alav, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi yaakov omer: lo min hashshem hu ze, ella mishshum dehave leh lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase – en lokin alav.

Ta shema: achal shene gidin mishshete yerechot mishshete vehemot – sofeg shemonim; rabbi yehuda omer: eno sofeg ella arbaim. hechi dame? illema beze achar ze uvishte hateraot – may tama derabbi yehuda deamar: arbaim vetu la? ella peshita bevat achat uvachada hateraa.
Man tanna kamma? ilema rabbanan difligi aleh desomchos – uma hatam, degufin muchelakin, patri rabbanan, hacha lo kol shekken? ella lav somchos hi!
Leolam beze achar ze, udekaamrat: may tama derabbi yehuda? kegon delet beh kezayit, detanya: achalo veen bo kezayit – chayyayv, rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyehe bo kezayit.

Mishna bearbaa perakim bashshana, hammocher behema lachavero tzarich lehodio: "immah macharti lishchot", "bittah macharti lishchot". veellu hen: erev yom tov haacharon shel chag, veerev yom tov harishon shel pesach, veerev atzeret, veerev rosh hashshana. uchedivre rabbi yose haggelili, af erev yom hakkippurim baggalil.

Amar rabbi yehuda: ematay – bizman sheen lo revach, aval yesh lo revach – en tzarich lehodio. umode rabbi yehuda bemocher et haem lechatan veet habbat lakkalla – shetztzarich lehodio, beyadua sheshshenehem shochatin beyom echad.

Bearbaa perakim ellu mashchitin et hattabbach beal korcho, afillu shor shave elef dinarim veen lo lelokeach ella dinar – kofin oto lishchot. lefichach, im met – met lallokeach. aval bishar yemot hashshana eno ken, lefichach im met – met lammocher.
Gemara tana, im lo hodio – holech veshochet veeno nimna.
Amar rabbi yehuda ematay. lema li lemitne et haem lechatan veet habbat lakkalla? milleta aggav orcheh kamashma lan, deorach ara lemitrach be chatna tefe mibbe challeta.
Bearbaa perakim ellu, veha lo mashach! amar rav huna amar rav: keshemmashach. i hachi, ema sefa: aval bishar yemot hashshana eno ken, lefichach im met – met lammocher, veha mashach!

Amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: leolam shello mashach, uchegon shezzikka lo al yede acher, bearbaa perakim ellu dizchut hu lo – zachin leadam shello befanav, bishar yemot hashshana dechov hu lo – en chavin laadam shello befanav.
Rabbi elazar omer, amar rabbi yochanan: bearbaa perakim ellu heemidu chachamim divrehem al din tora.
Deamar rabbi yochanan: devar tora – maot konot, uma taam amru meshicha kona – gezera shemma yomar lo "nisrefu chittecha baaliyya".

Mishna "yom echad" haamur beoto veet beno – hayyom holech achar hallayla. et zo darash rabbi shimon ben zoma: neemar bemaase vereshit "yom echad", veneemar beoto veet beno "yom echad" – ma "yom echad" haamur bemaase vereshit hayyom holech achar hallayla, af "yom echad" haamur beoto veet beno hayyom holech achar hallayla.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: et zo darash rabbi shimon ben zoma, lefi shekkol hainyan kullo eno medabber ella bekadashim, uvekadashim layla holech achar hayyom, yachol af ze ken? neemar kan "yom echad", veneemar bemaase vereshit "yom echad", ma "yom echad" haamur bemaase vereshit – hayyom holech achar hallayla, af yom haamur beoto veet beno – hayyom holech achar hallayla.
b: Rabbi omer: "yom echad" – yom hameyuchad taun karoz, mikkan amru: bearbaa perakim bashshana hammocher behema lachavero tzarich lehodio.
Hadaran alach oto veet beno.

Mishna kissuy haddam noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit, bechullin aval lo bemukedashin, venoheg bachayya uvaof, bimzumman uvesheeno mezumman, venoheg bechoy mippene shehu safek.
Veen shochatin oto beyom tov, veim shechato – en mechassin et damo.

Gemara mukedashin may tama la? illema mishshum derabbi zera, deamar rabbi zera: hashshochet tzarich sheyyitten afar lematta veafar lemala, shenneemar: "veshafach et damo vechissahu beafar" – "afar" lo neemar, ella "beafar", melammed shehashshochet tzarich sheyyitten afar lematta veafar lemala.
Vehacha la efshar, hechi lebed? littev velivatteleh – kamosef abbinyan, uchetiv: "hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil".
La livatteleh – ka have chatzitza.
Nehi dilmatta la efshar, lemala efshar, lebed kissuy!
Mi la tanya, rabbi yonatan ben yosef omer: shachat chayya veachar kach shachat behema – patur millechassot, behema veachar kach chayya – chayyayv lechassot.
Kidrabbi zera, deamar rabbi zera: kol harauy levilla – en billa meakkevet bo, vechol sheeno rauy levilla – billa meakkevet bo.
Veligrereh velichasseye? mi la tenan: dam hannittaz vesheal hassakkin chayyayv lechassot? alma degarer umechasse leh, hacha name nigror unechasse leh!
I bekodshe mizbeach – hachi name, hacha bemay askinan? bekodshe bedek habbayit.

a: Velifrekinhu velichassinhu? baenan haamada vehaaracha.
Ucheman? i kerabbi meir, deamar: hakkol hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha – haamar: shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita!
I kerabbi shimon, deamar: shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita – haamar: lo hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha?
Amar rav yosef: rabbi hi, venasev la allibba detannae; bishchita sheenah reuya – savar la kerabbi shimon, behaamada vehaaracha – savar la kerabbi meir.
Veibbaet ema: kulla rabbi shimon hi, veshane hacha deamar kera "veshafach vechissa", mi sheeno mechussar ella sheficha vechissuy, yatza ze shemchussar sheficha pediyyay vechissuy.
Vehasheta deatet lehachi, afillu tema kodshe mizbeach, mi sheeno mechussar ella sheficha vechissuy – yatza ze, shemchussar sheficha, gerira, vechissuy.
Mar bar rav ashe amar: amar kera "chayya o of", ma chayya enah kodesh, af of eno kodesh.
I ma chayya sheen bemino kodesh, af of sheen bemino kodesh, otzi torin uvene yona, sheyyesh beminan kodesh!
La, kechayya – ma chayya lo chillakta bah, af of lo tachlok bo.
Amar leh yaakov minaa lerava: kayyma lan chayya bichlal behema lesimanin, ema name behema bichlal chayya lechissuy.
Amar leh: alecha amar kera "al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim", ma mayim la bae kissuy, af hay name la bae kissuy.
Ella meatta, yatbilu bo? amar kera: "ach mayan uvor mikve mayim yihye tahor", hane in, midde acharina la.
Veema: hane mille lemaote shear mashkin, dela ikkero mayim, aval dam deikkeri mayim – hachi name?
Tere miute ketivi: "mayan mayim" "uvor mayim".
Ema: idde veidde lemaote shear mashkin, chad lemaote zochalin, vechad lemaote mechunnasin!
Telata miute ketivi: "mayan mayim", "uvor mayim", "mikve mayim".
Tanu rabbanan: "asher yatzud", en li ella asher yatzud, nitztzodin veomdin mealehen minnayin, kegon avavzin vetarnegolim?
Talmud lomar "tzed", mikkol makom. im ken, ma talmud lomar "asher yatzud"? limmeda tora derech eretz, shello yochal adam basar ella bahazemana hazzot.
Tanu rabbanan: "ki yarchiv Adonai elohecha et gevulcha" – limmeda tora derech eretz, shello yochal adam basar ella leteavon.

Yachol yikkach adam min hashshuk veyochal? talmud lomar: "vezavachta mibbekarcha umitztzoncha". yachol yizbach kol bekaro veyochal, kol tzono veyochal? talmud lomar: "mibbekarcha" – velo kol bekarcha, "mitztzoncha" – velo kol tzoncha.

Mikkan amar rabbi elazar ben azarya: mi sheyyesh lo mane – yikkach lefaso litra yarak, asara mane – yikkach lefaso litra dagim, chamishshim mane – yikkach lefaso litra basar, mea mane – yishpetu lo kedera bechol yom. veinach emat? meerev shabbat leerev shabbat.

Amar rav: tzerichin anu lachosh ledivre zaken. amar rabbi yochanan: abba mimmishpachat beriim hava, aval kegon anu, mi sheyyesh lo peruta betoch kiso – yeritzenna lachenvavni. amar rav nachman: kegon anu lovin veochlin.

"Kevasim lilvushecha" – miggez kevasim yehe malbushecha, "umechir sade attudim" – leolam yimkor adam sade veyikkach attudim, veal yimkor adam attudim veyikkach sade. "vede chalev izzim" – dayyo leadam sheyyitparnes mechalev gedayim utelaim shebbetoch beto.

"Lelachmecha lelechem betecha" – lachmecha kodem lelechem betecha. "vechayyim lenaarotecha" – amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman: ten chayyim lenaarotecha, mikkan limmeda tora derech eretz shello yelammed adam et beno basar veyayin.
Amar rabbi yochanan:
b: Harotze sheyyitashsher yaasok bivhema dakka. amar rav chisda, may dichtiv: "veashterot tzoncha" – shemmeashsherot et baalehen.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: kasa decharashin, vela kasa defoshrin. vehane mille bichli mattachot, aval bichli cheres let lan ba. uvichle mattachot name la amaran, ella dela shade behu tzivayya, aval shade behu tzivayya let lan ba. vechi la shade behu tzivayya name la amaran, ella dela tzitz, aval tzitz let lan ba.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: mi shehinniach lo aviv maot verotze leabbedan – yilbash kele fishtan, veyishtammesh bichle zechuchit, veyiskor poalim veal yeshev immahen. yilbosh kele fishtan – bechittana romita. veyishtammesh bichle zechuchit – bezuggita chivvarta. veyiskor poalim veal yashav immahen – betore dinfish pesedayyhu.

Daresh rav avvira, zimnin amar la mishshemeh derabbi amme, vezimnin amar la mishshemeh derabbi assi: may dichtiv "tov ish chonen umalve yechalkel devarav bemishpat"? leolam yochal adam veyishte pachot mimma sheyyesh lo, veyilbash veyitkasse bema sheyyesh lo, vichabbed ishto uvanav yoter mimma sheyyesh lo, shehen teluyin bo vehu taluy bemi sheamar vehaya haolam.

Daresh rav ena appitcha deve resh galuta: hashshochet lachole beshabbat chayyayv lechassot. amar lehu rabba: eshtoma kaamar, lishmetu leamoreh minneh, detanya: rabbi yose omer: koy en shochatin oto beyom tov, veim shechato en mechassin et damo.
Mikkal vachomer: uma mila shevvaddaah doche shabbat, en sefekah doche yom tov, kissuy sheen vaddao doche shabbat, en din sheen sefeko doche yom tov?
Amar lo: tekiat shofar bigvulim tochiach, sheen vaddaah doche shabbat, usefekah doche yom tov!
Heshiv rabbi elazar hakkappar beribbi teshuva: ma lemila shekken enah noheget belele yamim tovim, tomar bechissuy shennoheg belele yamim tovim!
Amar rabbi abba: ze echad min haddevarim sheamar rabbi chiyyay "en li alehem teshuva", veheshiv rabbi elazar hakkappar beribbi teshuva.
Katane mihat, kissuy sheen vaddao doche shabbat. may vaddao dechissuy dela dache shabbat? lav hashshochet lechole beshabbat?
Vedilma deavar veshachat?
Dumeya demila: ma mila birshut, af kissuy name birshut.
Amru lo: tekiat shofar baggevulin tochiach, sheen vaddaah doche shabbat, usefekah doche yom tov.
May sefekah? illema safek chol safek yom tov – hasheta vadday yom tov dachaya, safek yom tov safek chol mibbaya?

a: Ella sefek ish sefek ishsha.
Verabbi yose letameh, deamar: ishsha vaddait name taka. detanya: bene yisrael somchin, velo benot yisrael somchot.
Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: nashim somchot reshut.
Amar ravina: ulemay dekaamri rabbanan name it leh pircha, ma litkiat shofar shekken vaddaah doche shabbat bammikdash, tomar bechissuy deleteh kelal!
Heshiv rabbi elazar hakkappar beribbi: ma lemila shekken enah noheget belele yamim tovim. belele yamim tovim hu dela nahaga, bishar lele nahaga?

Ella, ma lemila – shekken enah noheget ballelot kevayyamim, tomar bechissuy – shennoheg ballelot kevayyamim! amar rabbi abba: ze echad min haddevarim sheamar rabbi chiyyay en alehen teshuva, veheshiv rabbi elazar berabbi teshuva.
Mishna hashshochet venimtzet terefa, vehashshochet laavoda zara, vehashshochet chullin bifnim vekadashim bachutz, chayya vaof hanniskalim – rabbi meir mechayyev, vachachamim potrim.
Hashshochet venitnabbela beyado, hannocher vehameakker – patur millechassot.
Gemara amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: raa rabbi devarav shel rabbi meir beoto veet beno, ushenao bilshon chachamim, uderabbi shimon bechissuy haddam, ushenao bilshon chachamim.
May tama derabbi meir beoto veet beno? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: gamar shechita shechita mishshechute chutz.
Ma hatam – shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita, af hacha name – shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita.
Verabbi shimon, may tama? amar rabbi mani bar pattish: gamar mittevoach tevach vehachen", ma lehallan shechita reuya, af kan shechita reuya.
Verabbi meir name, ligmar mittevoach"? danin shechita mishshechita, veen danin shechita mittevicha.
Ma nafka minna? ha tana deve rabbi yishmael: "veshav hakkohen" "uva hakkohen" – zo hi shiva zo hi bia.
Hane mille – hecha delekka dedame leh, aval ikka dedame leh – middedame leh yalfinan.
Verabbi shimon name ligmar mishshechute chutz? danin chullin mechullin, veen danin chullin mikkodashim.
Verabbi meir: attu oto veet beno bekadashim mi la naheg? hayeynu dekaamar rabbi chiyyay: raa rabbi devarav shel rabbi meir beoto veet beno, ushenao bilshon chachamim.

May tama derabbi meir bechissuy haddam? amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: gamar sheficha sheficha mishshechute chutz, ma lehallan – shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita, af kan – shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita.
Verabbi shimon: "asher yeachel" ketiv, verabbi meir: hahu lemaote of tame hu daata, verabbi shimon: of tame may tama – delav bar achila hu, terefa name – lav bar achila hu.
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi chiyyay: raa rabbi devarav shel rabbi shimon bechissuy haddam, ushenao bilshon chachamim.
Amar rabbi abba:
b: Lo lakkol amar rabbi meir shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita: mode rabbi meir sheen mattiratah baachila; velo lakkol amar rabbi shimon shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita: mode rabbi shimon shemmetahartah mide nevela.
Amar mar: lo lakkol amar rabbi meir shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita, mode rabbi meir sheen mattiratah baachila. peshita! terefa bishchita mi mishtarya?

La tzericha, leshochet et hatterefa umatza bah ben tisha chay; salka datach amena: hoil deamar rabbi meir: shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita, tahane leh shechitat immo vela live shechita, kamashma lan.
Vetisbera? vehaamar rabbi meir: ben pekua taun shechita!
La tzericha, derabbi savar la kerabbi meir vesavar la kerabbanan. savar la kerabbi meir, deamar: shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita, vesavar la kerabbanan, deamri: shechitat immo metaharto.
Kevan daamur rabbanan shechitat immo metaharto, tahane leh shechitat immo vela live shechita, ka mashma lan.

Velo lakkol amar rabbi shimon shechita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita, mode rabbi shimon shemmetahartah mide nevela. peshita! deamar rav yehuda amar rav, veamri la bematnita tana: "vechi yamut min habbehema", miktzat behema metammea umiktzat behema enah metammea, vee zo zo – terefa sheshshechatah.

La tzericha, leshochet et hatterefa vehi chullin baazara. detanya: hashshochet et hatterefa, vechen hashshochet venimtzet terefa, ze vaze chullin baazara – rabbi shimon mattir bahanaa, vachachamim osrin.
Salka datach amena, hoil veamar rabbi shimon: muttar bahanaa, alma lav shechita hi kelal, ema: mide nevela name la metahara, ka mashma lan.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: vesavar rabbi shimon chullin baazara deorayyta hi? amar leh: in, vehatnan rabbi shimon omer: chullin shennishchatu baazara yissarfu baesh, vechen chayya shennishchata baazara. i amrat bishlama deorayyta – hayeynu degazrinan chayya attu behema.
Ella i amrat derabbanan, behema may tama? dilma ate lemechal kadashim bachutz, hi gufa gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera?
Rabbi chiyyay nefal leh yaniva bechittaneh, ata lekammeh derabbi, amar leh: shekol ofa ushechot al buvita demayya, demorach dema veshavek leh.
Hechi aved hachi? vehatanya: hashshochet vetzarich laddam – chayyayv lechassot. ketzad yaase? o nocharo, o okro.
Ki ata rav dimi amar: "tze terof" amar leh, ki ata ravin amar: "tze nechor" amar leh.
Leman deamar "tze terof", may tama la amar "tze nechor"?

Vechi tema, kasavar en shechita laof min hattora, unechirato zo hi shechitato, vehatanya: rabbi omer: "kaasher tzivviticha" – melammed shennitztavva moshe al havveshet veal hakkane, veal rov echad baof, veal rov shenayim babbehema.

a: La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya "tze nechor" delav shechita hi kelal, aval "tze terof" ema shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita velive kissuy, ka mashma lan kidrabbi chiyyay bar abba.

Uleman deamar "tze nechor", may tama la amar "tze terof"? vechi tema kasavar shechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita, veha amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: raa rabbi devarav shel rabbi shimon bechissuy haddam, ushenao bilshon chachamim!

La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya "tze terof", dishchita sheenah reuya lo shemah shechita, aval "tze nechor" – ema: en shechita laof min hattora, unechirato zo hi shechitato, velive kissuy, ka mashma lan "kaasher tzivvitich".

Umi nefal leh yaniva bechittaneh? vehaamar ravin bar abba, veamri la amar rabbi avin bar sheva: mishshealu bene haggola pasku hazzikin vehazzevaot veharuchot veharamim, velo hechmitz yenam, velo laka pishtanam, venatnu chachamim enehem berabbi chiyyay uvanav.

Ki mahneya zechutayyhu – aalma, addidhu – la, kidrav yehuda amar rav, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: bechol yom vayom bat kol yotzet veomeret: kol haolam kullo nizzon bishvil chanina beni, vachanina beni day lo bekav charuvin meerev shabbat leerev shabbat.
Mishna cheresh shote vekatan sheshshachatu, vaacherim roin otam – chayyayv lechassot. benan leven atzman – patur millechassot.

Vechen leinyan oto veet beno, sheshshachatu vaacherim roin otan – asur lishchot acharehem, benan leven atzman – rabbi meir mattir lishchot acharehen, vachachamim osrim, umodim sheim shachat – sheeno sofeg et haarbaim.
Gemara verabbanan, may shena resha dela peligi, umay shena sefa difligi?
Resha, i amrinan chayyayvin lechassot, amri: shechita meallayyta hi, veate lemechal mishshechitatan.
Sefa name, kevan dekaamri rabbanan asur lishchot acharehem, amri: shechita meallayyta hi, veate lemechal mishshechitatan!
Sefa, amri: bisra dela ka mibbaya leh. resha name, amri: lenakker chatzero hu tzarich!
Shachat beashpa, may ikka lememar? ba limmalech, may ikka lememar?
Velitamaych, sefa name, ba limmalech – may ikka lememar?
Ella, rabbanan akkulla milleta peligi, venatri leh lerabbi meir ad demassek la lemilleta, vahadar peligi illaveh.
Bishlama rabbanan lechumera, ella rabbi meir – may tama?
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: mechayyev haya rabbi meir al shechitatan mishshum nevela. may tama? amar rabbi amme: hoil verov maasehen mekulekalim.

Amar leh rav pappa lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua, veamri la rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: may irya rov? afillu miut name, deha rabbi meir chayesh lemiuta, semoch miuta lachazaka, veittera leh rubba?

Ditnan: tinok shennimtza betzad haissa uvatzek beyado, rabbi meir metaher, vachachamim metammein, mippene sheddarko shel tinok letappeach. veamrinan: may tama derabbi meir? kasavar: rov tinokot metappechin, umiut en metappechin, veissa zo bechezkat tohora omedet,
b: Semoch miuta lachazaka veittera leh rubba.
Im amru sefek tumea letaher, yomru sefek issur lehattir?
Hora rabbi kerabbi meir, vehora rabbi kachachamim. he minnayyhu deacharita?

Ta shema: derabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba verabbi zera havo kayymi beshuka dekesari, appitcha deve midresha. nefak rabbi amme ashkechinhu, amar lehu: lav amena lechu beiddan be midresha la tekimu abbaray, dilma ikka inash demitztarcha leh shemata veate leitterode.

Rabbi zera al, rabbi abba la al. yatvi veka mibbaya lehu: he minnayyhu achrita? amar lehu rabbi zera: la shevaktun li deeyshayyeyleh lesava, dilma shemia leh meavu, vaavu minneh derabbi yochanan, derabbi chiyyay bar abba kol telatin yomin ka mahdar talmudeh kammeh derabbi yochanan.
May have ala? ta shema, deshalach rabbi elazar laggola: hora rabbi kerabbi meir. veha kerabbanan name ori! ella lav shema minna ha deacharita? shema minna.

Mishna shachat mea chayyot bemakom echad – kissuy echad lechullan, mea ofot bemakom echad – kissuy echad lechullan, chayya vaof bemakom echad – kissuy echad lechullan. rabbi yehuda omer: shachat chayya – yechassenna, veachar kach yishchot et haof.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: chayya – kol mashma chayya, ben merubba uven muetet; of – kol mashma of, ben merubbe uven muat; mikkan amru: shachat mea chayyot bemakom echad – kissuy echad lechullan, mea ofot bemakom echad – kissuy echad lechullan, chayya vaof bemakom echad – kissuy echad lechullan.
Rabbi yehuda omer: shachat chayya – yechassenna, veachar kach yishchot et haof, shenneemar: "chayya o of".
Amru lo: hare hu omer "ki nefesh kol basar damo venafsho hu", may ka mehadderi leh? hachi kaamri leh rabbanan: hay "o" mibbee leh lechallek.
Verabbi yehuda: lechallek – middamo" nafka, verabbanan: "damo" tuva mashma, dichtiv: "ki nefesh kol basar damo venafsho hu".

Amar rabbi chanina: mode haya rabbi yehuda leinyan beracha, sheeno mevarech ella beracha achat. amar leh ravina lerav acha bereh derava, veamri la rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: may shena mittalmide derav?

Derav berona verav chananel talmide derav havo yatvi bisodta, kae alayyhu rav yeva sava, amaru leh: hav livarech. hadur amaru leh: hav lishte. amar lehu rav yeva sava: hachi amar rav, kevan daamar "hav livarech" ittesar leh lemishte chamra. hacha name, kevan deittappal leh lechissuy ichayyayv leh livracha.

a: Hachi hasheta?! hatam mishte uvaroche bahade hadade la efshar, hacha efshar deshachet bachada umechasse bachada.
Mishna shachat velo kissa, veraahu acher – chayyayv lechassot. kissahu venitgalla – patur millechassot. (kissahu) [kissattu] haruach – chayyayv lechassot.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "veshafach vechissa" – mi sheshshafach yechasse. shachat velo kissa, veraahu acher, minnayin shechayyayv lechassot? shenneemar: "vaomar livne yisrael" – azhara lechol bene yisrael.

Tanya iddach: "veshafach vechissa", bamme sheshshafach – bo yechasse, shello yechassennu baregel, shello yihyu mitzvot bezuyot alav. tanya iddach: "veshafach vechissa", mi sheshshafach – hu yechassennu. maase beechad sheshshachat, vekadam chavero vechissa, vechiyyeyvo rabban gamliel litten lo asara zehuvim.
Ibbaya lehu: sechar mitzva o sechar beracha? lemay nafka minna? levirkat hammazon. i amrat sechar mitzva – achat hi, vei amrat sechar beracha – havyayn arbaim. may?

Ta shema, daamar leh hahu mina lerabbi: mi sheyyatzar harim lo bara ruach, umi shebbara ruach lo yatzar harim, dichtiv: "ki hinne yotzer harim uvore ruach". amar leh: shote, shefel lesefeh dikra – "Adonai tzevaot shemo".
Amar leh: nekot li zimna telata yome umahdarna lach teyuveta. yetev rabbi telat taaniyyata. ki hava ka bae mivra, amaru leh: mina kae abbava. amar: "vayyittenu bevaruti rosh vegomer".

Amar leh: rabbi, mevasser tovot ani lach, lo matza teshuva oyivcha venafal min haggag vamet. amar lo: retzoncha shettisod etzli? amar lo: hen. leachar sheachlu veshatu, amar lo: kos shel beracha atta shote o arbaim zehuvim atta notel? amar lo: kos shel beracha ani shote. yatzta bat kol veamra: kos shel beracha shave arbaim zehuvim.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: adayin yeshnah leotah mishpacha ben gedole romi, vekorin otah mishpachat bar luyanus.
Kissahu venitgalla. amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: may shena mehashavat aveda, deamar mar: "hashev" – afillu mea peamim.
Amar leh: hatam la ketiv miuta, hacha ketiv miuta "vechissahu".

Kissahu haruach. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shechazar venitgalla, aval lo chazar venitgalla – patur millechassot. vechi chazar venitgalla may have? ha iddechi leh! amar rav pappa: zot omeret en dichuy etzel mitzvot.
Umay shena meha detanya: hashshochet venivla dam bakkarka – chayyayv lechassot. hatam kesherishshumo nikkar.
Mishna dam shennitarev bemayim, im yesh bo marit dam – chayyayv lechassot. nitarev beyayin – roin oto keillu hu mayim. nitarev bedam habbehema
b: O bedam hachayya – roin oto keillu hen mayim. rabbi yehuda omer: en dam mevattel dam.
Dam hannittaz vesheal hassakkin – chayyayv lechassot. amar rabbi yehuda: ematay? bizman sheen sham dam ella hu, aval yesh sham dam shello hu – patur millechassot.

Gemara tenan hatam: dam shennitarev bemayim, im yesh bo marit dam – kasher. nitarev beyayin – roin oto keillu hu mayim. nitarev bedam behema o bedam hachayya – roin oto keillu hu mayim. rabbi yehuda omer: en dam mevattel dam.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shennaflu mayim letoch dam, aval nafal dam letoch mayim – rishon rishon batel.
Amar rav pappa: uleinyan kissuy eno ken, en dichuy etzel mitzvot.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol mare addemumit – mechapperin, umachshirin, vechayyayvin bechissuy. may kamashma lan? mechapperin – tenena, chayyayvin bechissuy – tenena!
Machshirin itztericha leh. machshirin name, i dam – achshore machshar, i mayya – achshore machsheri! la tzericha, shettimmedo beme geshamim.
Me geshamim name, kevan deshakel verame, achshevinhu. la tzericha, shennitmedu mealehen.
Rabbi assi minneharbil omer: bitzlalta didma. rabbi yirmeya middifti amar: anush karet, vehu deikka kezayit. bematnita tana: metammeim beohel, vehu deikka reviit.

Tenan hatam: kol mashke hammet tehorin, chutz middamo, vechol mare addemumit shebbo metammein beohel. umashke hammet tehorin? ureminhu: mashke tevul yom, mashkin hayyotzin mimmennu kemashkin shennogea bahen,

a: Veellu vaellu en metammein, ushear kol hattemein, ben kallin ben chamurin – mashkin hayyotzin mehen kemashke hannogea bahen, veellu vaellu techilla, chutz min hammashke shehu av hattumea.
May kallin umay chamurin? may lav: kallin – sheretz vezav, vachamurin – met? la, kallin – sheretz, vachamurin – zav.
May shena zav, digzaru beh rabbanan, umay shena met dela gezaru beh rabbanan? zav dela bedili inashe minneh – gezaru beh rabbanan, met divdili inashe minneh – la gezaru beh rabbanan.

Dam hannittaz vesheal hassakkin, tanu rabbanan: "vechissahu" – melammed sheddam hannittaz vesheal hassakkin chayyayv lechassot. amar rabbi yehuda: ematay? bizman sheen sham dam ella hu, aval yesh sham dam shello hu – patur millechassot.

Tanya iddach: "vechissahu" – melammed shekkol damo chayyayv lechassot, mikkan amru: dam hannittaz vesheal agappayim chayyayv lechassot. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim – shello kissa dam hannefesh, aval kissa dam hannefesh – patur millechassot.
Bemay ka mippalgi? rabbanan savri: "damo" – kol damo, rabbi yehuda savar: "damo" – vaafillu miktzat damo, verabban shimon ben gamliel savar: "damo" – hameyuchad.

Mishna bamme mechassin uvamme en mechassin? mechassin bezevel haddak, uvechol haddak, besid, uvecharsit, uvilvena uvimgufa shekketashan, aval en mechassin lo bezevel haggas, velo bechol haggas, velo bilvena uvimgufa shello ketashan, velo yichpe alav et hakkeli. kelal amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: davar shemmegaddel bo tzemachim – mechassin bo, vesheeno megaddel tzemachim – en mechassin bo.

Gemara hechi dame chol haddak? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol sheen hayyotzer tzarich lechotsho. veikka dematne la assefa: aval en mechassin lo bezevel haggas velo bechol haggas. hechi dame chol haggas? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol shehayyotzer tzarich lechotsho.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu ditzrich vela tzerich, demipperich ipperoche.

Tanu rabbanan: "vechissahu", yachol yechassennu baavanim o yichpe alav et hakkeli? talmud lomar: "beafar". veen li ella afar, minnayin lerabbot zevel haddak, vechol haddak, ushechikat avanim, ushechikat charsit, uneoret pishtan dakka,
b: Unesoret shel charashin dakka, vesid, vecharsit levana umegufa shekketashan? talmud lomar: "vechissahu". yachol sheani merabbe af zevel haggas, vechol haggas, ushechikat kele mattachot, ulevena umegufa shello ketashan, vekemach, vesubbin, umuresan? talmud lomar: "beafar".
Uma raita lerabbot et ellu ulehotzi et ellu? achar sheribba hakkatuv umiet, merabbe ani et ellu shehen min afar, umotzi ani et ellu sheenan min afar.
Ema: "vechissahu" – kalal, "afar" – parat, kelal uferat – en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat, afar – in, midde acharina – la!
Amar rav mari: mishshum dehave kelal hatztzarich lifrat, vechol kelal hatztzarich lifrat – en danin oto bichlal uferat.
Darash rav nachman bar rav chisda: en mechassim ella bedavar shezzorin bo umatzmiach. amar rava: hay burecha!

Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: may burechateh? ana amrita nihaleh, umeha matnita amrita nihaleh: haya mehallech bammidbar, veen lo efer lechassot – shochek dinar zahav umechasse. haya mehallech bisfina, veen lo afar lechassot – soref tallito umechasse.
Bishlama soref tallito umechasse, ashkechan efer deikkeri afar, ella dinar zahav menalan? amar rabbi zera: "veafrot zahav lo".

Tanu rabbanan: en mechassin ella beafar, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel omrim: matzinu efer shekkaruy afar, shenneemar "velakchu lattame meafar serefat". uvet shammay: afar serefa ikkeri, afar setama la ikkeri.
Tana: hosifu alehen hashshechor, vehakkechol, venikrat pissulin, veyesh omrim: af hazzarnich.
Amar rava: bischar sheamar avraham avinu "veanochi afar vaefer", zachu banav lishte mitzvot: efer para, vaafar sota.
Velichshov name afar kissuy haddam? hatam hechsher mitzva ikka, hanaa lekka.
Veamar rava: bischar sheamar avraham avinu

a: "Im michut vead seroch naal", zachu banav lishte mitzvot: lechut shel techelet, uretzua shel tefillin.
Bishlama retzua shel tefillin, ketiv: "verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha", vetanya: rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: ellu tefillin shebbarosh, ella chut shel techelet may hi?

Detanya, rabbi meir omer: ma nishtanna techelet mikkol hatztzivonin? mippene shettechelet dome layyam, veyam dome larakia, verakia dome leeven sappir, veeven sappir dome lechisse hakkavod, dichtiv: "vayyiru et elohe yisrael vetachat raglav vegomer", uchetiv: "kemare even sappir demut kisse".
Amar rabbi abba: kashe gazel hanneechol, sheafillu tzaddikim gemurim enan yecholin lehacheziro, shenneemar: "biladay rak asher achlu hannearim".

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: kol makom sheatta motze devarav shel rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili bahaggada – ase oznecha kaafarkeset. "lo merubbechem mikkol haammim chashak Adonai bachem vegomer" – amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: choshkani bachem, sheafillu beshaa sheani mashpia lachem gedulla – attem memaatin atzmechem lefanay.
Natatti gedulla leavraham – amar lefanay: "veanochi afar vaefer", lemoshe veaharon – amar: "venachnu ma", ledavid – amar: "veanochi tolaat velo ish".

Aval ummot haolam enan ken, natatti gedulla lenimrod – amar: "hava nivne lanu ir", lefaro – amar: "mi Adonai", lesancheriv – amar: "mi bechol elohe haaratzot vegomer", linvuchadnetztzar – amar: "eele al bomote av", lechiram melech tzor – amar: "moshav elohim yashavti belev yammim".

Amar rava, veittema rabbi yochanan: gadol shenneemar bemoshe veaharon yoter mimma shenneemar beavraham, deillu beavraham ketiv: "veanochi afar vaefer", veillu bemoshe veaharon ketiv: "venachnu ma". veamar rava, veittema rabbi yochanan: en haolam mitkayyem ella bishvil moshe veaharon, ketiv hacha: "venachnu ma", uchetiv hatam: "tole aretz al belima".

Amar rabbi ila: en haolam mitkayyem ella bishvil mi shebbolem et atzmo bishat meriva, shenneemar: "tole eretz al belima". rabbi avahu amar: mi shemmesim atzmo kemi sheeno, shenneemar: "umittachat zeroot olam".

Amar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv "haumnam elem tzedek tedabberun mesharim tishpetu bene adam"? ma ummanuto shel adam baolam hazze – yasim atzmo keillem. yachol af ledivre tora? talmud lomar "tzedek tedabberun". yachol yagis dato? talmud lomar "mesharim tishpetu bene adam".
Amar rabbi zeera, veittema rabba bar yirmeya: mechassin baafar ir hanniddachat. veammay? issure hanaa hu!
Amar zeeri: lo nitzrecha ella laafar afarah, dichtiv: "veet kol shelalah tikbotz el toch rechovah vesarafta", mi sheeno mechussar ella kevitza userefa, yatza ze shemchussar telisha, kevitza userefa.
Verava amar: mitzvot lav lehanot nittenu.
Yatev ravina vekaamar la leha shemata, etiveh rav rechumi leravina: shofar shel avoda zara lo yitka bo. may lav, im taka lo yatza? la, im taka yatza.
Lulav shel avoda zara lo yittol. may lav, im natal lo yatza? la, im natal yatza. vehatanya: taka lo yatza, natal lo yatza!
Amar rav ashe: hachi hasheta? hatam
b: Shiura baenan, vaavoda zara kattote mechattat shiura. hacha, kol ma dimchattat mealle lechissuy.
Hadaran alach kissuy haddam.

Mishna gid hannashe noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit, bachullin uvammukedashin, venoheg bivhema uvechayya, beyarech shel yamin uveyarech shel semol, veeno noheg baof – mippene sheen lo kaf.
Venoheg bashshelil. rabbi yehuda omer: eno noheg bashshelil, vechelbo muttar.
Veen hattabbachin neemanin al gid hannashe, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: neemanin alav veal hachelev.
Gemara mukedashin – peshita! mishshum deakdesheh peka leh issur gid minneh?

Vechi tema yesh begidin benoten taam, veate issur mukedashin vechayel aissur gid, hay "mukedashin noheg begid" mibbee leh. ella kasavar en begidin benoten taam, uvemukedashin issur gid ikka, issur mukedashin lekka.
Vesavar tanna didan en begidin benoten taam? vehatnan: yarech shennitbashshel bah gid hannashe, im yesh bah benoten taam – hare zo asura!
Ella, hacha bevaldot kadashim askinan, vekasavar noheg bashshelil, vekasavar valdot kadashim bime imman hen kedoshim, deissur gid veissur mukedashin bahade hadade kaate.
Umi matzet mokmat la bishlil, veha middekatane sefa "noheg bashshelil", mikkelal deresha lav bishlil askinan! hachi kaamar: davar ze machloket derabbi yehuda verabbanan.
Umi matzet amrat detarvayyhu bahade hadade kaatu? vehatnan: al ellu tumeot hannazir megalleach, al hammet veal kezayit min hammet.
Vekashya lan: al kezayit min hammet megalleach, al kullo lo kol shekken? veamar rabbi yochanan: lo nitzrecha ella lenefel shello (nakesharev) [nitkashsheru] evarav begidin.

a: Alma issur mukedashin kadem!
Af al gav deissur mukedashin kadem, ate issur gid chayel alayyhu, shekken issuro noheg bivne noach.
Man shamat leh hay sevara? rabbi yehuda, veha matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda, dekatane: noheg bivhema uvechayya, beyarech shel yamin uveyarech shel semol!
Hay tanna savar la kevavteh bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
Emar deshamat leh lerabbi yehuda bitmea, deissur lav, kadashim deissur karet – mi shamat leh?
Ella, hacha bimvakkeret askinan, devarechem kadosh.
