Vei baet ema: valdot kadashim bahavavyaytan hen kedoshim.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar yosef: lo shanu ella kodashim hanneechalin, aval kadashim sheenan neechalin – en issur gid noheg bahen. verabbi yochanan amar: echad kadashim hanneechalin veechad kadashim sheen neechalin – issur gid noheg bahen.
Amar rav pappa: vela peligi, kan – lehalekoto, kan – lehaaloto.
Ikka deamri, amar rav pappa: vela peligi – kan lecholtzo, vechan lehaaloto.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: lehaaloto peligi, detanya: "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha" – lerabbot haatzamot vehaggidin vehakkeranayim vehattelafayim.
Yachol afillu pershu, talmud lomar "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam".

I basar vadam, yachol yachlotz gidim vaatzamot veyaale basar legabbe mizbeach? talmud lomar: "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha". ha ketzad? mechubbarin – yaalu, pershu, afillu berosho shel mizbeach – yerdu.
Uman tanna deshamat leh deamar pershu yerdu? rabbi hi, detanya: "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol" – lerabbot haatzamot vehaggidim vehakkeranayim vehattelafayim, vaafillu pershu.
Veha, ma ani mekayyem "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam"? befokin. ha ketzad? ikkule vasar – atta machazir, vei atta machazir ikkule gidim vaatzamot.

Rabbi omer: katuv echad omer "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol" – ribba, vechatuv echad omer "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam" – miet, ha ketzad? mechubbarin – yaalu, pershu – afillu berosho shel mizbeach yerdu.
Verabbanan, mechubbarin la itzterich kera lerabboye, mide dehave aroshah shel ola, ki itzterich kera lefershu.
Verabbi, mechubbarin dehettera
b: La itzterich kera lerabboye, ki itzterich kera legid hannashe bimchubbar.
Verabbanan, "mimmashke yisrael" – min hammuttar leyisrael.
Verabbi, mide dehave achelev vadam. verabbanan, mitzvatan bechach shane.
Amar rav huna: gid hannashe shel ola choltzo lattappuach. amar rav chisda: mari dechi, mi ketiv "al ken lo yochal hammizbeach"? "al ken lo yochlu vene yisrael" ketiv.
Verav huna, "mimmashke yisrael" – min hammuttar leyisrael.
Metivi: gid hannashe shel shelamim – mechabbedo laamma, veshel ola – maalehu. may lav, maalehu umaktiro?
Lo, maalehu vecholtzo. umeachar shecholtzo lamma maalehu, mishshum shenneemar "hakerivehu na lefechatecha".
Tanya kevavteh derav huna: gid hannashe shel shelamim – mechabbedo laamma, veshel ola – choltzo lattappuach.
Tenan hatam: tappuach haya beemtza hammizbeach, peamim haya alav kishlosh meot kor. amar rava: guzema.
Hishku et hattamid bechos shel zahav, amar rava: guzema.
Amar rabbi amme: dibbera tora leshon havay, dibberu neviim leshon havay, dibberu chachamim leshon havay. dibberu chachamim leshon havay – ha daamaran.
Dibbera tora leshon havay – "arim gedolot uvetzurot bashshamayim", dibberu neviim leshon havay – "vattibbaka haaretz lekolam".
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani amar shemuel: bishlosha mekomot dibberu chachamim leshon havay, ellu hen: tappuach, gefen, ufarochet. tappuach – ha daamaran.

Gefen – ditnan: gefen shel zahav hayta omedet al pitcho shel hechol, mudela al gabbe kelonsot, vechol mi shehaya mitnaddev garger o eshkol – mevi vetole bah. amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok: maase haya, venimnu aleha shelosh meot kohanim lefannotah.

Parochet, ditnan: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon hassegan – parochet ovyah tefach, veal shivim ushenayim nirim neereget, veal kol nima venima esrim vearbaa chutin. orkah arbaim baamma, verochbah esrim beamma, umishshemonim ushete ribbo naaset, ushetayim osim beshana, vshlosh meot kohanim matbilin otah.
Beyarech shel yamin uveyarech shel semol. matnitin la kerabbi yehuda, detanya: rabbi yehuda omer: eno noheg ella beachat, vehaddaat machraat et shel yamin.
Ibbaya lehu: mifshat peshita leh lerabbi yehuda, umay daat? daat tora, o dilma sappoke mesappeka leh, umay daat? daat nota.

Ta shema: haatzamot vehaggidim vehannotar yissarfu leshishsha asar. vehavenan ba: hane gide may avidtayyhu? i gide vasar – lechlinhu, vei deiyyaytur – hayeynu notar! ella gide tzavvar, i lav basar ninhu – lishdinhu?
Veamar rav chisda: lo nitzrecha ella legid hannashe, veallibba derabbi yehuda, deamar: eno noheg ella beachat.
I amrat bishlama sappoke mesappeka leh – shappir, ella i amrat mifshat peshita leh dehettera – lechleh, deissura – lishdeyeh!
Amar rav ika bar chanina: leolam ema lach mifshat peshita leh, vehacha bemay askinan – keshehukkeru ulevassof nitarvu.

a: Rav ashe amar: lo nitzrecha ella leshomno, detanya: shomno muttar, veyisrael kedoshim nahagu bo issur.

Ravina amar: lo nitzrecha ella lechidrav yehuda amar shemuel, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel, shene gidin hen: penimi samuch leetzem – asur, vechayyayvin alav; chitzon samuch levasar – asur, veen chayyayvin alav.
Ta shema: achal mizze kezayit umizze kezayit – sofeg shemonim, rabbi yehuda omer: eno sofeg ella arbaim.
I amrat bishlama mifshat peshita leh – shappir, ella i amrat sappoke mesappeka leh – havya la hateraat safek, veshaminan leh lerabbi yehuda deamar: hateraat safek lo shemah hateraa.

Detanya: hikka et ze, vechazar vehikka et ze, killel et ze, vechazar vekillel et ze, hikka shenehem bevat achat, o shekkillel shenehem bevat achat – chayyayv. rabbi yehuda omer: bevat achat – chayyayv, beze achar ze – patur.
Hay tanna savar la keiddach tanna derabbi yehuda, deamar: hateraat safek shemah hateraa.
Detanya: "lo totiru mimmennu ad boker vegomer" – ba hakkatuv litten ase achar lo taase, lomar sheen lokin alav, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi yaakov omer: lo min hashshem hu ze, ella mishshum dehave lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase – en lokin alav.
Ta shema: achal shene gidin mishshete yerechot mishshete vehemot – sofeg shemonim; rabbi yehuda omer: eno sofeg ella arbaim.
Middekaamar mishte yerechot mishshete vehemot, peshita detarvayyhu leissura, ulerabbi yehuda itzterich. shema minna mifshat peshita leh, shema minna.
Vei peshita leh, ammay sofeg arbaim vetu la? lilke shemonim! hacha bemay askinan – kegon delet bo kezayit, detanya: achalo veen bo kezayit – chayyayv, rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyehe bo kezayit.
Vetama may? amar rava: amar kera "hayyarech" – hameyummenet shebbayyarech.
Verabbanan, hahu defashet issureh bechulleh yarech, leappoke chitzon dela.
Verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: amar kera "beheavko immo" – keadam shechovek et chavero, veyado maggaat lechaf yemino shel chavero.
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: kegoy nidma lo, deamar mar: yisrael shennitpal lo goy badderech – toflo limino.
Rav shemuel bar acha kammeh derav pappa mishshemeh derava bar ulla amar: ketalmid chacham nidma lo, deamar mar: hamehallech limin rabbo – hare ze bur.
Verabbanan, meachoreh ata, venashsheyeh betarvayyhu.

Verabbanan, hay "beheavko immo" may darshi beh? mibbee leh lichiddach derabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: melammed sheheelu avak margelotam ad kisse hakkavod, ketiv hacha "beheavko immo", uchetiv hatam "veanan avak raglav".
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lamma nikra shemo gid hannashe? shennasha mimmekomo veala, vechen hu omer: "nashta gevuratam hayu lenashim".
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "davar shalach beyaakov venafal beyisrael"? "davar shalach beyaakov" – ze gid hannashe, "venafal beyisrael" – sheppashat issuro bechol yisrael.
Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "utevoach tevach vehachen"? pera lahen bet hashshechita, "vehachen" – tol gid hannashe bifnehem, keman deamar gid hannashe neesar livne noach.

"Vayyivvater yaakov levaddo", amar rabbi elazar: shennishtayyer al pakkin ketannim, mikkan latztzaddikim shechaviv alehem mamonam yoter miggufam, vechol kach lamma? lefi sheen poshtin yedehen begazel.
"Vayyeavek ish immo ad alot hashshachar", amar rabbi yitzchak: mikkan letalmid chacham shello yetze yechidi ballayla. rabbi abba bar kahana amar mehacha:
b: "Hinne hu zore et goren hasseorim".
Rabbi avahu amar mehacha: "vayyashkem avraham babboker vayyachavosh et vegomer".
Verabbanan amri mehacha: "lech na ree et shelom achecha veet shelom vegomer".
Rav amar mehacha: "vayyizrach lo hashshemesh".

Amar rabbi akiva: shaalti et rabban gamliel veet rabbi yehoshua baitliz shel imaum, shehalchu likkach behema lemishte veno shel rabban gamliel. ketiv "vayyizrach lo hashshemesh", vechi shemesh lo levad zarcha? vahalo lechol haolam zarcha!

Amar rabbi yitzchak: shemesh habbaa baavuro zarcha baavuro, dichtiv: "vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava vayyelech charana", uchetiv: "vayyifga bammakom". ki meta lecharan amar: efshar avarti al makom shehitpallelu avotay vaani lo hitpallalti? kad yahev dateh lemihdar, kefatza leh ara, miyyad – "vayyifga bammakom".
Kad tzalli, bae lemehdar, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: tzaddik ze ba levet meloni, veyippater belo lina? miyyad, "ba hashshemesh".

Ketiv "vayyikkach meavne hammakom", uchetiv "vayyikkach et haeven". amar rabbi yitzchak: melammed shennitkabbetzu kol otan avanim lemakom echad, vechol achat veachat omeret: "alay yanniach tzaddik ze rosho". tana: vechullan nivleu beechad.

"Vayyachalom vehinne sullam mutztzav artza", tana: kamma rochbo shel sullam? shemonat alafim parsaot, dichtiv: "vehinne malache elohim olim veyordim bo", "olim" – shenayim, "veyordim" – shenayim, vechi fagu bahade hadade havu lehu arbaa.
Uchetiv beh bemalach "ugeviyyato chetarshish", ugemiri detarshish tere alfe parse have.

Tana: olin umistakkelin bidyokno shel mala, veyordin umistakkelin bidyokno shel matta. beo lesakkoneh, miyyad "vehinne Adonai nitztzav alav". amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: ilmale mikra katuv i efshar leomro, keadam shemmenif al beno.

"Haaretz asher atta shochev aleha vegomer", may revuteh? amar rabbi yitzchak: melammed shekkippelah hakkadosh baruch hu lechol eretz yisrael vehinnicha tachat yaakov avinu, shettehe nocha likkavesh levanav.
"Vayyomer shallecheni ki ala hashshachar", amar lo: gannav atta o kuveyusetus atta shemmityayre min hashshachar? amar lo: malach ani, umiyyom shennivreti lo higgia zemanni lomar shira ad achshav.

Mesayyay leh lerav chananel amar rav, deamar rav chananel amar rav: shalosh kittot shel malache hashsharet omrot shira bechol yom, achat omeret "kadosh", veachat omeret "kadosh", veachat omeret "kadosh Adonai tzevaot".

Metivi: chavivin yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu yoter mimmalache hashsharet, sheyyisrael omrim shira bechol shaa, umalache hashsharet en omrim shira ella paam achat bayyom, veamri la paam achat beshabbat, veamri la paam achat bechodesh, veamri la paam achat bashshana, veamri la paam achat beshavua, veamri la paam achat beyovel, veamri la paam achat baolam.

Veyisrael mazkirin et hashshem achar shete tevot, shenneemar: "shema yisrael Adonai vegomer", umalache hashsharet en mazkirin et hashshem ella leachar shalosh tevot, kedichtiv: "kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzevaot".
Veen malache hashsharet omrim shira lemala, ad sheyyomru yisrael lematta, shenneemar: "beron yachad kochve voker", vahadar "vayyariu kol bene elohim".
Ella, achat omeret "kadosh", veachat omeret "kadosh kadosh", veachat omeret "kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzevaot". vehaikka "baruch"!

a: "Baruch" – ofannim hu deamri leh. veibbaet ema: kevan deityehiv reshuta, ityehiv.
"Vayyasar el malach vayyuchol bacha vayyitchannen lo" – eni yodea mi naasa sar lemi, keshehu omer "ki sarita im elohim" – heve omer yaakov naasa sar lammalach.
"Bacha vayyitchannen lo" – eni yodea mi bacha lemi, keshehu omer "vayyomer shallecheni", heve omer: malach bacha leyaakov.
"Ki sarita im elohim veim anashim", amar rabba: remez ramaz lo sheatidim shene sarim latzet mimmennu, rosh gola shebbevavel venasi shebbeeretz yisrael, mikkan ramaz lo galut.

"Uvaggefen shelosha sarigim", amar rav chiyyay bar abba amar rav: ellu shelosha sare geim hayyotzim miyyisrael bechol dor vador, peamim sheshshenayim kan veechad beeretz yisrael, peamim sheshshenayim beeretz yisrael veechad kan. yehivu rabbanan enayyhu berabbana ukeva verabbana nechemya bene veratte derav.
Rava amar: ellu shelosha sare goyim, shemlammedim zechut al yisrael bechol dor vador.

Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: "gefen" – ze haolam, "shelosha serigim" – ze avraham yitzchak veyaakov, "vehi cheforachat alta nitztzah" – ellu haimmahot, "hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim" – ellu hashshevatim.

Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: vechi marin lo leadam ma shehaya? vahalo en marin lo leadam ella ma sheatid lihyot! ella "gefen" – ze tora, "shelosha sarigim" – ellu moshe veaharon umiryam, "vehi cheforachat alta nitztzah" – ellu sanhedrin, "hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim" – ellu hatztzaddikim shebbechol dor vador.

Amar rabban gamliel: adayin tzerichin anu lammodai, demokem leh kulleh bechad makom. rabbi elazar hammodai omer: "gefen" – ze yerushalayim, "shelosha sarigim" – ze mikdash, melech, vechohen gadol, "vehi cheforachat alta nitztzah" – ellu pirche chehunna, "hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim" – ellu nesachim.

Rabbi yehoshua ben levi mokem la bemattanot, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: "gefen" – zo tora, "shelosha sarigim" – ze beer, ammud anan, uman, "vehi cheforachat alta nitztzah" – ellu habbikkurim, "hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim" – ellu nesachim.

Rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar: "gefen" – ellu yisrael, vechen hu omer: "gefen mimmitzrayim tassia". "shelosha sarigim" – ellu shelosha regalim sheyyisrael olin bahen bechol shana veshana. "vehi cheforachat alta nitztzah" – higgia zemannan shel yisrael lifrot velirbot, vechen hu omer: "uvene yisrael paru vayyishretzu".

"Alta nitztza" – higgia zeman shel yisrael liggael, vechen hu omer: "veyez nitzcham al begaday vechol malbushay egalti", "hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim" – higgia zemannah shel mitzrayim lishtot kos hattarela.
Vehayeynu deamar rava: shelosha kosot haamurot bemitzrayim lama? echad, sheshshatat bime moshe, veechad sheshshatat bime paro necho, veechad sheatida lishtot im kol haggoyim.
Amar leh rabbi abba lerabbi yirmeya bar abba: ki daresh lehu rav lehane kerae beaggadta, kevavtach daresh lehu.

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: umma zo kegefen nimshela. zemorot shebbah – ellu baale vattim, eshkolot shebbah – ellu talmide chachamim, alin shebbah – ellu amme haaretz, kenokanot shebbah – ellu rekanim shebbeyisrael.
Vehayeynu dishlachu mittam: live rachamim itkalayya al alayya, deilmale alayya la mitkayyeyman itkalayya.
"Vaekkereha li bachamishsha asar kasef", amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: en "kira" ella leshon mechira, shenneemar "bekivri asher kariti li".
"Bachamishsha asar" – ze chamishsha asar benisan shebbo nigalu yisrael mimmitzrayim, "kasef" – ellu tzaddikim, vechen hu omer "tzeror hakkesef lakach beyado".

"Chomer seorim veletech seorim" – ellu arbaim vachamishsha tzaddikim shehaolam mitkayyem bahem, veeni yodea im sheloshim kan vachamishsha asar beeretz yisrael, veim sheloshim beeretz yisrael vachamishsha asar kan. keshehu omer: "vaekcha sheloshim hakkesef vaashlich oto bet Adonai el hayyotzer" – heve omer: sheloshim beeretz yisrael vachamishsha asar kan.
Amar abbaye: verubbayyhu mishtachchi beve chenishta detute appeta, vehayeynu dichtiv: "vaomar alehem im tov beenechem havu sechari veim lo chadalu vayyishkelu et sechari sheloshim kasef".
Rabbi yehuda omer: ellu sheloshim tzaddike ummot haolam, sheummot haolam mitkayyeymim alehem. ulla amar: ellu sheloshim mitzvot shekkibbelu alehem bene noach, veen mekayyeymin ella shelosha. achat
b: Sheen kotvin ketubba lizcharim, veachat sheen shoklin besar hammet bemakolin, veachat shemmechabbedin et hattora.
Veeno noheg baof. veha ka chazenan deit leh? it leh, vela agil.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: it leh leof vaagil, it leh livhema vela agil, may? batar dideh azlinan, o batar mineh azlinan? teku.
Venoheg bashshelil. amar shemuel: vechelbo muttar ledivre hakkol.
Chelbo demay? ilema dishlil – veha miflag peligi beh, detanya: noheg bashshelil, vechelbo asur, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: eno noheg bashshelil, vechelbo muttar.
Veamar rabbi elazar, amar rabbi oshaya: machloket beven tisha chay, vehalach rabbi meir leshitato, verabbi yehuda leshitato.
Veella chelbo degid? ha miflag peligi bah, detanya: gid hannashe mechattet acharav bechol makom shehu, vechotech shomno meikkaro – divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: gommo im hashshofi.

Leolam chelbo degid, mode shemuel dilrabbi meir midderabbanan asur, detanya: veshomno muttar, veyisrael kedoshim nahagu bo issur. may lav rabbi meir hi, deamar: muttar min hattora veasur midderabbanan?
Mimmay dilma rabbi yehuda hi, aval lerabbi meir middeorayyta name asir!
La salka datach, detanya: gid hannashe mechattet acharav bechol makom shehu, veshomno muttar. man shamat leh deit leh chatita? rabbi meir, vekaamar: shomno muttar.
Amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta, amar rav: lo asra tora ella kenokanot shebbo. ulla amar: etz hu, vehattora chiyyeyva alav.

Amar abbaye: kevavteh deulla mistabbera, deamar rav sheshet amar rav assi: chutin shebbachelev asurin, veen chayyayvin alehen, alma "chelev" amar rachamana velo chutin, hacha name "gid" amar rachamana velo kenokanot.
Gufa: amar rav sheshet amar rav assi: chutin shebbachelev asurin, veen chayyayvin alehen. shebbakkuleya asurin, veen chayyayvin alehen. loven kuleya – rabbi verabbi chiyyay: chad asar, vechad share.
Rabba memartet leh, rabbi yochanan memartet leh, rabbi assi gaem leh. amar abbaye: kevavteh derabbi assi mistabbera, deamar rabbi abba amar rav yehuda amar shemuel:
